# Innovation. Service. Integrity.

As leaders in building materials innovation, ISI Building Products manufactures cutting-edge vapor
barrier, insulation and building wrap brands. The design and ingenuity of these products reflects
our mission: to create impactful solutions for building and construction challenges.
* ## Vapor Barrier
* ## Insulation
* ## Building Wrap
* ## Private Label

### Building Envelope Solutions

With corporate headquarters in East Peoria, IL and manufacturing facilities throughout the Midwest,
ISI is a building products manufacturer catering to construction customers throughout North America.
Our centralized operations and strategically placed warehousing allow for efficient distribution to
locations in the US, Canada and Mexico.

Operating since 1997, ISI is proud of the loyalty and level of trust we have earned from respected
vendors, distributors, contractors and clients. As a leading building material manufacturer in the
USA, we are committed to providing high-performance products for the construction industry and
custom, quality solutions for our customers — with the service to back it up.

### Innovative Materials Engineering

As a top building material supplier, ISI helps create energy efficient, weather-protected homes and
buildings. We believe our products are only as good as what goes into them.

 Our research and development process starts with customer feedback. Using our industry expertise,
we find ways to utilize the finest materials and manufacturing technologies to provide high caliber,
market-leading products. Attention to detail and technical expertise helps us stand out among
construction material suppliers.

The Critical Safety Challenge

## Thermal Runaway
## Is a Chain Reaction

When a single lithium-ion cell fails, it can release extreme heat — rapidly propagating to
neighboring cells and triggering a cascading thermal event that endangers the entire battery system.

01

#### Cell-Level Failure

Internal short circuit or defect causes rapid temperature rise exceeding 400°C within a single cell.

02

#### Heat Propagation

Without adequate barriers, thermal energy conducts to adjacent cells through direct contact and hot
gas venting at 350°C+.

03

#### Cascading Failure

Multiple cells enter thermal runaway, creating an uncontrolled exothermic event with risk of fire
and explosion.

**Levron Aerogel Felt withstands 1000°C direct flame exposure** — even at just 2cm thickness, it
outlasts 5cm rock wool + 4cm glass wool combined. Passive thermal protection as the last line of
defense.

#### Why Do Lithium-Ion Batteries Burn?

Li-ion batteries contain liquid electrolyte separated by thin semi-permeable separators. During
overcharging, cycling, or mechanical deformation, cells can overheat past the critical 170°C
threshold — igniting the electrolyte, which generates its own oxygen and creates self-sustaining
jet-flame combustion that conventional methods cannot extinguish.

## Precision-Engineered
## Aerogel Material Science

Not commodity insulation. A chemistry-led material platform with 7 years of dedicated R&D —
combining nano-porous aerogel architecture with proprietary Sol-Gel processing.

[Aerogel material cross-section showing nano-porous structure at 50-100nm scale]
Nano-Porous Architecture
Silica-based aerogel with 50–100 nm nano-cell diameters. Air molecules are physically constrained,
limiting convection and conduction. Contains >90% air by volume — one of the lightest solid
materials known.
Proprietary Sol-Gel Process
Our production method is designed completely differently from traditional approaches. Focus: easily
derive nano-products from various raw material types. 7 years of R&D, thousands of lab experiments,
refined to industrial scale.
Multi-Material Platform
Beyond silica aerogel: our R&D lab also produces Polymer Aerogel, Metal Oxide Aerogel, Carbon
Aerogel, and Cellulose Aerogel — enabling next-generation materials for emerging applications.
Flexible Composite Engineering
Glass wool or ceramic wool reinforcement enables felt from standard (650°C) to extreme (1300°C)
temperature variants. Custom multilayer composites designed for specific application requirements.
**R&D approach:** We don't sell a single product SKU. We engineer application-specific aerogel
solutions — from felt thickness and reinforcement type to granule particle size and transparency
level.

## Is a Chain Reaction

When a single lithium-ion cell fails, it can release extreme heat — rapidly propagating to
neighboring cells and triggering a cascading thermal event that endangers the entire battery system.

#### Cell-Level Failure

Internal short circuit or defect causes rapid temperature rise exceeding 400°C within a single cell.

02

#### Heat Propagation

Without adequate barriers, thermal energy conducts to adjacent cells through direct contact and hot
gas venting at 350°C+.

03

#### Cascading Failure

Multiple cells enter thermal runaway, creating an uncontrolled exothermic event with risk of fire
and explosion.

**Levron Aerogel Felt withstands 1000°C direct flame exposure** — even at just 2cm thickness, it
outlasts 5cm rock wool + 4cm glass wool combined. Passive thermal protection as the last line of
defense.

#### Why Do Lithium-Ion Batteries Burn?

Li-ion batteries contain liquid electrolyte separated by thin semi-permeable separators. During
overcharging, cycling, or mechanical deformation, cells can overheat past the critical 170°C
threshold — igniting the electrolyte, which generates its own oxygen and creates self-sustaining
jet-flame combustion that conventional methods cannot extinguish.

## Precision-Engineered
## Aerogel Material Science

Not commodity insulation. A chemistry-led material platform with 7 years of dedicated R&D —
combining nano-porous aerogel architecture with proprietary Sol-Gel processing.

[Aerogel material cross-section showing nano-porous structure at 50-100nm scale]
Nano-Porous Architecture
Silica-based aerogel with 50–100 nm nano-cell diameters. Air molecules are physically constrained,
limiting convection and conduction. Contains >90% air by volume — one of the lightest solid
materials known.
Proprietary Sol-Gel Process
Our production method is designed completely differently from traditional approaches. Focus: easily
derive nano-products from various raw material types. 7 years of R&D, thousands of lab experiments,
refined to industrial scale.
Multi-Material Platform
Beyond silica aerogel: our R&D lab also produces Polymer Aerogel, Metal Oxide Aerogel, Carbon
Aerogel, and Cellulose Aerogel — enabling next-generation materials for emerging applications.
Flexible Composite Engineering
Glass wool or ceramic wool reinforcement enables felt from standard (650°C) to extreme (1300°C)
temperature variants. Custom multilayer composites designed for specific application requirements.
**R&D approach:** We don't sell a single product SKU. We engineer application-specific aerogel
solutions — from felt thickness and reinforcement type to granule particle size and transparency
level.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Which Insulation do I Need?

At **Aerolam**, we offer a wide range of insulation solutions, including **XLPE Insulation, Bubble
Insulation,** and **Pre-Insulated Sheets (Aerocomfort).** The right insulation depends on your
application—whether it’s for HVAC systems, industrial buildings, or residential projects. Our team
can assist you in selecting the most appropriate product based on thermal, acoustic, and
environmental requirements.

What is k-Value?

The k-value refers to a material’s thermal conductivity. A lower k-value means the insulation is
more effective in restricting heat transfer. Aerolam’s insulation products are designed with low
k-values, ensuring superior thermal performance and energy efficiency.

What is the Importance of Vapour Resistance Value?

Vapour resistance is crucial in preventing moisture ingress, which can cause condensation, mould
growth, and reduce insulation efficiency. Aerolam insulation products offer excellent vapour
resistance, making them ideal for humid environments and HVAC ducting applications.

What are the Benefits of Insulation?
* Insulation from Aerolam provides multiple benefits:
* Enhanced energy efficiency
* Lower heating and cooling costs
* Improved indoor comfort
* Noise reduction
* Condensation control
* Fire resistance and sustainability
How Long does Insulation Last?

Aerolam insulation products are manufactured using high-quality, durable materials. With proper
installation and conditions, they can last 25–30 years or more, retaining their thermal and
mechanical performance over time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Which Insulation do I Need?

At **Aerolam**, we offer a wide range of insulation solutions, including **XLPE Insulation, Bubble
Insulation,** and **Pre-Insulated Sheets (Aerocomfort).** The right insulation depends on your
application—whether it’s for HVAC systems, industrial buildings, or residential projects. Our team
can assist you in selecting the most appropriate product based on thermal, acoustic, and
environmental requirements.

What is k-Value?

The k-value refers to a material’s thermal conductivity. A lower k-value means the insulation is
more effective in restricting heat transfer. Aerolam’s insulation products are designed with low
k-values, ensuring superior thermal performance and energy efficiency.

What is the Importance of Vapour Resistance Value?

Vapour resistance is crucial in preventing moisture ingress, which can cause condensation, mould
growth, and reduce insulation efficiency. Aerolam insulation products offer excellent vapour
resistance, making them ideal for humid environments and HVAC ducting applications.

What are the Benefits of Insulation?
* Insulation from Aerolam provides multiple benefits:
* Enhanced energy efficiency
* Lower heating and cooling costs
* Improved indoor comfort
* Noise reduction
* Condensation control
* Fire resistance and sustainability
How Long does Insulation Last?

Aerolam insulation products are manufactured using high-quality, durable materials. With proper
installation and conditions, they can last 25–30 years or more, retaining their thermal and
mechanical performance over time.

#### Markets & applications

AIS, (incorporating Covertherm, AIS Marine, Bardot, CRP Subsea, Ovun, Imenco Aqua, and Matrix
Composites & Engineering) is an award-winning global supplier of insulation, passive fire
protection, buoyancy, and cable protection systems. From design and build to installation and
maintenance, our customers count on us to deliver best-in-class service advanced material products —
off-the-shelf and bespoke — that perform in the world’s most challenging environments.

# Protecting life, infrastructure, equipment and vital assets on land & sea

[Play video][160]
[ Scroll to explore ][161]

#### Markets & applications

AIS, (incorporating Covertherm, AIS Marine, Bardot, CRP Subsea, Ovun, Imenco Aqua, and Matrix
Composites & Engineering) is an award-winning global supplier of insulation, passive fire
protection, buoyancy, and cable protection systems. From design and build to installation and
maintenance, our customers count on us to deliver best-in-class service advanced material products —
off-the-shelf and bespoke — that perform in the world’s most challenging environments.

## ALUTIX INSULATIONS

Alutix Insulations has been established with an aim to be the country’s leading manufacturer of the
Aluminium Air Bubble Insulation, which is also known as Thermal Reflective Insulation.

Reflective insulation is an insulating and energy conserving product that adds an air cushion,
usually in the form of plastic bubble material, between layers of aluminium foil to improve the
insulating value or R-value of what would otherwise be a simple radiant barrier.

# Why Insulation is Important

[Alutix Insulation]

Insulation means protecting an area from heat. Traditional insulation methods like fiberglass or
metal can protect your premise form convection & conduction heat but are ineffective against radiant
energy, which causes green house effect in your premises but also affects the overall atmospheric
temperature.

Keeping these factors in mind , it is important to choose the right kind of insulation for your
premises. with 96% reflection ratio, thermal insulations are the most preferred kind of insulations
available in the market today.

## Why Alutix Insulation?

At Alutix, we produce Aluminium Air Bubble Insulation, which reflect(block) the radiant energy to
enter in your premise & thus help you maintain the temperature inside. Our manufacturing unit is
located in Raipur , Chhaattigarh.

The state of the art plant boasts of the world's finest thermal insulation manufacturing machines
with High-Speed production facility backed by the dedicated and experienced teams of motivated
members.

Our production process uses the most efficient method of manufacturing insulation material which
helps us to offer superior & consistent quality products at a competitive price.

# Why Insulation is Important

[Alutix Insulation]

Insulation means protecting an area from heat. Traditional insulation methods like fiberglass or
metal can protect your premise form convection & conduction heat but are ineffective against radiant
energy, which causes green house effect in your premises but also affects the overall atmospheric
temperature.

Keeping these factors in mind , it is important to choose the right kind of insulation for your
premises. with 96% reflection ratio, thermal insulations are the most preferred kind of insulations
available in the market today.

## Why Alutix Insulation?

At Alutix, we produce Aluminium Air Bubble Insulation, which reflect(block) the radiant energy to
enter in your premise & thus help you maintain the temperature inside. Our manufacturing unit is
located in Raipur , Chhaattigarh.

The state of the art plant boasts of the world's finest thermal insulation manufacturing machines
with High-Speed production facility backed by the dedicated and experienced teams of motivated
members.

Our production process uses the most efficient method of manufacturing insulation material which
helps us to offer superior & consistent quality products at a competitive price.

# Your Expert Commercial and Industrial
# Insulation Suppliers

[View Our Products][83]

Looking for a trade partner specializing in all things insulation? Bay Insulation Supply offers a
nationwide presence combined with local service appeal to offer our customers exactly what they
need. What do we bring to the table? Unrivaled customer service and industry expertise, proven track
record, competitive pricing, national footprint, a wide range of service capabilities, and a
dedication to safety above all else.

## Mechanical

Prevent energy loss, control condensation, regulate temperature, and protect those who come in
contact with the elements of mechanical infrastructure with thermal insulation.

[View Mechanical Products][84]

## HVAC

Bay Insulation Supply offers the industry’s most expansive line of HVAC insulation solutions for
both residential and commercial projects alike.

[View HVAC Products][85]

### The National Insulation Association (NIA) Named Bay Insulation Supply a 2025 Platinum Winner of
### the Safety Excellence Award

Bay Insulation is honored to be one of NIA’s Safety Excellence Award recipients. Companies like ours
have gone above and beyond to improve their safety programs, helping to ensure safe working
environments and smooth project operations.

NIA’s Safety Award is the only national award for outstanding safety performance in the mechanical
insulation industry. NIA created the award program more than a decade ago to recognize top companies
that have established structured safety programs to ensure the well-being of their employees and
create safe working environments.

Prevent energy loss, control condensation, regulate temperature, and protect those who come in

both residential and commercial projects alike.

## Clean energy-tech for a new energy era

Ready to turn a whole industry upside down? Ready to focus all your energy on clean energy? Join the
hundreds of people across Europe who are united behind the common goal of getting Europe off gas.

## Join a passionate team of people

At Aira, our talented teams across Europe are united behind the common goal of getting Europe off
gas. From our headquarters in Stockholm to our factory in Poland, we work across international
markets to innovate and launch products designed to make a meaningful impact on the world.

With a diverse and inclusive working environment, we welcome talent from all backgrounds and
cultures to join us in advancing the next generation of home energy solutions.

* [Workplace image]

* [Workplace image]

## Find your perfect fit

## Aira Clean Energy Technicians

****If you’re a gas boiler engineer, plumber or electrician looking to retrain, the Aira Academy
offers exciting opportunities to expand your skill set and open new doors.
[
Explore the roles][17]

## Aira Clean Energy Expert

****We are always looking for passionate, enthusiastic people to join our teams the UK, Italy and
Germany selling our heat pumps to homeowners at their kitchen tables.

[Explore the roles][18]

## Sales, support & services

****Our clean energy-tech mission relies on you. Explore the back-office opportunities that make it
all possible.

[Explore the roles][19]

## Business operations

Discover opportunities in our offices across various roles, including administration, supply chain,
marketing, tech, and other key positions.

[Explore the roles][20]

## Values we live by

### Dare to fly

With courage and passion, we embrace uncertainty and reach new heights.

### Be global citizens

We lead with care and respect, building for the now without compromising the future.

### Empower our customers to do the right thing

We do the right thing by our customers, so they can do the right thing by the planet.

### Freedom to discover

Curious minds and an appetite for adventure lets us feel comfortable with failure and inspired by
learning.

## What’s it like to work at Aira?
* > Working at Aira has been a life-changing experience. It’s a startup on steroids. Never before
  > have I experienced a company growing at such a high pace while upholding such a high-performing
  > environment.
  
  Douglas Dracke
  
  GTM Manager
* > I've had the privilege to spearhead innovative campaigns that not only elevate our brand but
  > also contribute to a cleaner, sustainable future.
  
  Lucy Manning
  
  Marketing Manager
* > Aira is a fantastic place to work with great people, a progressive environment, and strong
  > growth potential.
  
  Nikki Harrison
  
  Academy Electrical

## critical thinkers collaborators innovators

one-stop thermal insulation solutions, including rock wool insulation, glass wool, and ceramic fiber
insulation with OEM/ODM services tailored to industrial, construction, and energy applications.

Our Process

## How Does Our PAS 2035 Retrofit Process Work for Homes in the UK?

We follow the PAS 2035 framework to ensure quality, compliance, and energy performance at every
stage.

1

### Assessment (C1)

We conduct an in-depth energy assessment of your property using thermal imaging and diagnostic
tools. We identify heat loss areas, insulation gaps, ventilation issues, and improvement
opportunities — and check your eligibility for ECO4, the Boiler Upgrade Scheme, and other government
grants.

**Deliverable:** Retrofit assessment report with prioritised recommendations and cost estimates.

2

### Planning (C2)

We create a tailored retrofit plan with specific measures for increasing energy efficiency and
compliance. We specify materials, design details, and risk assessments — and handle ECO4 eligibility
checks, Boiler Upgrade Scheme grant applications, and all funding paperwork on your behalf.

**Deliverable:** Retrofit design specification and funding application.

3

### Coordination (C3)

We manage all coordination activities including scheduling, contractor supervision, and compliance
checks. You have one point of contact for your entire project. We ensure all installers are PAS 2030
certified and follow MCS standards.

**Deliverable:** Installation sign-off certificate and quality monitoring reports.

4

### Compliance (C4)

We ensure all work meets PAS 2030, PAS 2035, EPC, and building regulations. We provide audit-ready
documentation for ECO4, the Warm Homes: Social Housing Fund, and other funding schemes — and check
how actual performance compares with predictions.

**Deliverable:** Post-retrofit compliance certificate and performance verification.

Why Clients Choose Us

## Why Do Homeowners, Landlords, and Housing Associations Across the UK Choose Compliant Retrofits?

### PAS 2035 Expertise

Our team of retrofit assessors, coordinators and designers works to the PAS 2035 framework end to
end — we understand it inside out and make sure your project meets all compliance requirements.

### 100% UK-Focused with Manchester Expertise

We specialise in UK building regulations, PAS standards, the TrustMark framework, and government
funding schemes including ECO4, the Boiler Upgrade Scheme, and the Warm Homes: Social Housing Fund
(formerly SHDF). We stay up to date with all policy changes so you don’t have to — and our local
knowledge of Manchester properties means we understand the specific challenges of Victorian
terraces, 1930s semis, and modern homes.

### End-to-End Support

From consultation to project management and final inspections, we handle everything. No need to
coordinate multiple contractors. No chasing. No fragmented services. One point of contact from start
to finish.

### Quality Assurance

Every project follows the highest standards. We use BBA-approved materials, CIGA-guaranteed
installations (where applicable), and provide full certification. We follow RECC consumer protection
standards proactively — transparent pricing, a 14-day cooling-off period, and free dispute
resolution.

Standards

## What Accreditation Standards Does Compliant Retrofits Work To?

We follow RECC consumer protection standards (transparent pricing, a 14-day cooling-off period, free
dispute resolution) and MCS installation standards proactively — and where a scheme requires a
specific certification, delivery is through certified partners.

TrustMark — framework we work to PAS 2035 — retrofit coordination & assessment PAS 2030 — ECO4
installation standard MCS — via certified installation partners RECC Code of Practice — we follow
proactively CHAS — we align with ISO 9001 / 14001 / 27001 / 45

how actual performance compares with predictions.

**Deliverable:** Post-retrofit compliance certificate and performance verification.

Why Clients Choose Us

## Why Do Homeowners, Landlords, and Housing Associations Across the UK Choose Compliant Retrofits?

### PAS 2035 Expertise

Our team of retrofit assessors, coordinators and designers works to the PAS 2035 framework end to
end — we understand it inside out and make sure your project meets all compliance requirements.

### 100% UK-Focused with Manchester Expertise

We specialise in UK building regulations, PAS standards, the TrustMark framework, and government
funding schemes including ECO4, the Boiler Upgrade Scheme, and the Warm Homes: Social Housing Fund
(formerly SHDF). We stay up to date with all policy changes so you don’t have to — and our local
knowledge of Manchester properties means we understand the specific challenges of Victorian
terraces, 1930s semis, and modern homes.

### End-to-End Support

From consultation to project management and final inspections, we handle everything. No need to
coordinate multiple contractors. No chasing. No fragmented services. One point of contact from start
to finish.

### Quality Assurance

Every project follows the highest standards. We use BBA-approved materials, CIGA-guaranteed
installations (where applicable), and provide full certification. We follow RECC consumer protection
standards proactively — transparent pricing, a 14-day cooling-off period, and free dispute
resolution.

Standards

## What Accreditation Standards Does Compliant Retrofits Work To?

We follow RECC consumer protection standards (transparent pricing, a 14-day cooling-off period, free
dispute resolution) and MCS installation standards proactively — and where a scheme requires a
specific certification, delivery is through certified partners.

TrustMark — framework we work to PAS 2035 — retrofit coordination & assessment PAS 2030 — ECO4
installation standard MCS — via certified installation partners RECC Code of Practice — we follow
proactively CHAS — we align with ISO 9001 / 14001 / 27001 / 45

## Custom Product Development

Since the beginning, Dunmore has utilized an evolving stage gate development process. The stage gate
system is a road-map to efficiently and effectively take your ideas and turn them into commercial
products. Dunmore's drive to create and innovate has led to an extensive technology portfolio. Our
range of technology, combined with our [collaborative approach to development][119] brings your
project to life.

## About DUNMORE

For more than 50 years, the Dunmore brand has stood for quality in [coated][120], [laminated][121]
and [metalized films][122]. During that time, several diverse industries have come to know our name,
as a [films manufacturer / coated films manufacturer][123], for outstanding standard and specialty
products. Today, they often turn to us first with new challenges untried innovations and
experimental applications.

industries on their journey to net-zero.

 

With decades of expertise, we engineer and manufacture world-class mica based industrial insulation
solutions designed to meet the toughest performance standards. Our products deliver superior
electrical, thermal and mechanical protection, enabling cutting-edge technologies to fight the
climate crisis.

## [EmiratesGBC at the WorldGBC Leadership Summit][57]

The Emirates Green Building Council Chair, Vice Chair, and CEO participated in the WorldGBC
Leadership Summit 2026 in London (21–24 June), a key global gathering for the sustainable built
environment sector.

The Summit featured the Global Solutions Forum, regional MENA Green Building Council discussions
with 11 councils on shared challenges and collaboration opportunities, as well as capacity-building
workshops and the WorldGBC Annual General Meeting.

## [Sustainability Lounge by EmiratesGBC- Episode 1][58]

Hosted by Mario Saab, Board Member of the council and Director of Sustainability MENA at Cundall,
the council invited a very special guest in the UAE environment community to tell us about the
importance of green buildings and protecting the environment. Dr. Habiba Al Mar’ashi, Co-founder,
Vice-chair and Treasurer of the council and Co-founder and Chairperson of the Emirates Environmental
Group

[EmiratesGBC Podcast][59]

## [MENA Green Building Awards 2026][60]

 Applications are now OPEN for the 14th cycle of the MENA Green Building Awards 2026!

Organized by the Emirates Green Building Council and endorsed by the World Green Building Council,
the awards continue to recognize and celebrate outstanding impact in sustainable buildings and
communities across the MENA region.

[Know More][61]

## [Join the Movement for a Sustainable Future][62]

At EmiratesGBC, we believe that every action counts in the journey towards sustainability. Our
initiatives are designed to empower individuals and organizations to make impactful changes. Whether
you are a seasoned professional or just starting your sustainability journey, there is a place for
you in our community. Together, we can create a greener, healthier environment for generations to
come.

[Know More][63]

## [Emirates Green Building Council Annual Report 2024][64]

2024 Emirates Green Building Council Annual Report aknowledge a year of impactful progress and
milestones. This report highlights our key initiatives, collaborations, and achievements in
promoting sustainable building practices across the UAE, aligning with national climate goals,
advancing energy efficiency, and driving green innovation in the built environment.

Discover the report and join us in reflecting on the collective efforts that fuel the sustainability
movement.

[Know More][65]

## [Emirates Green Building Council Market Brief 2024][66]

Emirates Green Building Council market brieft provides a comprehensive overview of the UAE’s
evolving green building landscape, highlighting  local green building regulations, certification
systems, and the nation’s progress toward its Net Zero 2050 ambitions. From national programs such
as Estidama and Barjeel to internationally recognized certifications like LEED, BREEAM, and WELL,
the Market Brief serves as a valuable resource for industry professionals.

## [EmiratesGBC at the WorldGBC Leadership Summit][57]

The Emirates Green Building Council Chair, Vice Chair, and CEO participated in the WorldGBC
Leadership Summit 2026 in London (21–24 June), a key global gathering for the sustainable built
environment sector.

The Summit featured the Global Solutions Forum, regional MENA Green Building Council discussions
with 11 councils on shared challenges and collaboration opportunities, as well as capacity-building
workshops and the WorldGBC Annual General Meeting.

## [Sustainability Lounge by EmiratesGBC- Episode 1][58]

Hosted by Mario Saab, Board Member of the council and Director of Sustainability MENA at Cundall,
the council invited a very special guest in the UAE environment community to tell us about the
importance of green buildings and protecting the environment. Dr. Habiba Al Mar’ashi, Co-founder,
Vice-chair and Treasurer of the council and Co-founder and Chairperson of the Emirates Environmental
Group

[EmiratesGBC Podcast][59]

## [MENA Green Building Awards 2026][60]

 Applications are now OPEN for the 14th cycle of the MENA Green Building Awards 2026!

Organized by the Emirates Green Building Council and endorsed by the World Green Building Council,
the awards continue to recognize and celebrate outstanding impact in sustainable buildings and
communities across the MENA region.

[Know More][61]

## [Join the Movement for a Sustainable Future][62]

At EmiratesGBC, we believe that every action counts in the journey towards sustainability. Our
initiatives are designed to empower individuals and organizations to make impactful changes. Whether
you are a seasoned professional or just starting your sustainability journey, there is a place for
you in our community. Together, we can create a greener, healthier environment for generations to
come.

[Know More][63]

## [Emirates Green Building Council Annual Report 2024][64]

2024 Emirates Green Building Council Annual Report aknowledge a year of impactful progress and
milestones. This report highlights our key initiatives, collaborations, and achievements in
promoting sustainable building practices across the UAE, aligning with national climate goals,
advancing energy efficiency, and driving green innovation in the built environment.

Discover the report and join us in reflecting on the collective efforts that fuel the sustainability
movement.

[Know More][65]

## [Emirates Green Building Council Market Brief 2024][66]

Emirates Green Building Council market brieft provides a comprehensive overview of the UAE’s
evolving green building landscape, highlighting  local green building regulations, certification
systems, and the nation’s progress toward its Net Zero 2050 ambitions. From national programs such
as Estidama and Barjeel to internationally recognized certifications like LEED, BREEAM, and WELL,
the Market Brief serves as a valuable resource for industry professionals. 

[Know More][67]

years.

# Suppliers of high-quality waterproofing and insulation products for use on residential, commercial
# infrastructure and mining projects.

In this new era of sustainable building and responsible living, we are driving the industry to find
superior solutions for building regulation and certification. We assist you to improve the quality
and compliance of construction work throughout Australia.
Improved insulation capacities support the overall energy efficiency as well as impacting many other
parts of your building projects, such as electronics, which can create all sorts of related fire and
electrocution hazards.

## how we stand out

### PROVEN DURABILITY

Real-life membrane samples are consecutively tested by the external laboratory Belgian Building
Research Institute (BBRI) an supervised by independent quality-control organisation SGS
International in different continents and climate zones.

The life expectancy of our [waterproofing membranes][75] is currently 25 to 35 years based on the
actual condition of exposed DuO membranes worldwide.

### LOCAL EXPERTISE

Enduroflex is based in Sydney’s Northern Beaches and has been servicing  Australia with
DuO waterproofing membranes. DuO has been installed in Australia and New Zealand for more than 15
years.

The product is developed and adapted to withstand the local climate conditions and is fully aligned
with local application procedures, standards and regulations.

# Firwin Corporation: Custom Insulation Products

for Diesel and Gas Engines, Exhaust Systems, and Industrial Applications

[[Browse Our Engine Library]][194]
[[Browse Our Resource Library]][195]

## Who We Are

Firwin Corporation is a leading manufacturer of custom insulation products for diesel and gas
engines, exhaust systems, and a variety of industrial applications. Our three primary product lines
include: removable and reusable insulation blankets (also known as insulation covers or jackets),
permanent Hard Coat™ composite insulation, and our Metal Foil Insulation (MFI) solutions, ideal for
applications requiring a lightweight, durable, and easy-to-clean insulation barrier. We also
maintain a broad inventory of off-the-shelf high-temperature tapes and sleeves to meet diverse
thermal protection needs.

### Frequently Asked Questions
* ### Who are the people behind the company, and what is the history?
  
  We are a family-owned and operated business that has proudly served the region since 2016. Our
  dedicated team brings over a decade of combined industry knowledge to every project. Unlike larger
  corporations, our owner is actively involved in every installation to ensure high standards of
  quality and transparency are met on every job site. As leading spray foam insulation contractors
  in Branson, MO, we value the trust you place in us. We know construction inside and out, providing
  outstanding services that boost energy efficiency and comfort.
* ### What does it mean when you say you are a ProFoam Certified Installer?
  
  Being ProFoam Certified means our technicians have undergone rigorous professional training
  specifically tailored for polyurethane applications. This certification ensures we utilize the
  latest industry techniques, maintain strict safety standards, and possess a comprehensive
  understanding of how products interact with different building structures. It means a more
  reliable, highly energy-efficient seal that performs exactly as advertised. We continually invest
  in our education, making sure we remain your top choice when looking for dependable spray foam
  insulation contractors in Branson, MO. We understand how proper application impacts building
  performance, reduces utility costs, and creates a superior indoor environment.
* ### What is the difference between open-cell and closed-cell products, and which one do I need?
  
  The best choice depends on your specific goals and the area being treated. Open-cell is
  lightweight, flexible, and excellent for interior walls or areas requiring enhanced acoustic
  control. Closed-cell is denser, provides a higher R-value per inch, and acts as a robust moisture
  barrier, making it perfect for crawlspaces, basements, or areas desiring structural reinforcement.
  During our complimentary estimate process, our technicians carefully assess your space to develop
  the absolute best plan tailored to your requirements. Because we are dedicated spray foam
  insulation contractors in Branson, MO, we ensure you receive the most effective solution for
  optimal temperature regulation.
* ### Do I need to leave my home or business during the installation process?
  
  For most application projects, we recommend that residents, employees, and pets vacate the
  premises during active spraying and for a specific re-occupancy period after the job is finished.
  This curing timeframe allows the material to set and ensures any off-gassing is thoroughly
  ventilated away from living spaces. We will provide a clear, easy-to-understand timeline during
  your initial consultation so you can plan your day without unexpected disruptions. Our thorough
  approach is one reason locals consistently choose us as their preferred spray foam insulation
  contractors in Branson, MO.
* ### I noticed that you offer a five-year warranty; what exactly does this cover?
  
  We proudly stand behind our craftsmanship and the materials we utilize. Our five-year warranty
  covers the integrity of the professional installation, ensuring the material remains properly
  adhered and continues to provide the tight thermal envelope we promised. If you notice any unusual
  issues related to the physical application within that timeframe, we will return to carefully
  inspect the area and rectify the problem at no additional cost. As highly dependable [spray foam
  insulation contractors in Branson, MO][87], we want you to have peace of mind knowing your
  investment is fully protected against application defects.
* ### How do I qualify for the military, veteran, and first responder discounts you offer?
  
  We at Foam Brothers Insulation are incredibly proud to support the brave individuals who serve our

  emergency medical technicians. Simply mention your service background when you call to schedule

  Being ProFoam Certified means our technicians have undergone rigorous professional training

  insulation contractors in Branson, MO. We understand how proper application impacts building
  performance, reduces utility costs, and creates a superior indoor environment.
* ### What is the difference between open-cell and closed-cell products, and which one do I need?
  
  The best choice depends on your specific goals and the area being treated. Open-cell is
  lightweight, flexible, and excellent for interior walls or areas requiring enhanced acoustic
  control. Closed-cell is denser, provides a higher R-value per inch, and acts as a robust moisture
  barrier, making it perfect for crawlspaces, basements, or areas desiring structural reinforcement.
  During our complimentary estimate process, our technicians carefully assess your space to develop
  the absolute best plan tailored to your requirements. Because we are dedicated spray foam
  insulation contractors in Branson, MO, we ensure you receive the most effective solution for
  optimal temperature regulation.

  premises during active spraying and for a specific re-occupancy period after the job is finished.
  This curing timeframe allows the material to set and ensures any off-gassing is thoroughly
  ventilated away from living spaces. We will provide a clear, easy-to-understand timeline during

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

Hi, I’m Dima, founder and CEO at GetProspect.

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid

I had experience building SAAS tools and created MVP in just a couple of months. I worked so great,

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,
send them, and close deals. Our goal is to build a great company with a startup culture where we are
happy to work and deliver outstanding services that customers will love. We rely on the latest
technologies and trends to bring  innovations to our users.

I hope you’ll feel our love through the product and it will bring true value.

Please, let me know if we can do something even better.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

# We’re national.
# We’re local.
# But mostly,
# we’re people.

## Who we are.

Installed Building Products is the premier installation contractor for insulation for residential
and commercial builders with over 10,000 employees serving more than 250 locations nationwide.

As a national organization, we have access to the best products and training available. This,
combined with our exceptional local talent, empowers us to both impact our communities and provide
the highest quality service to our customers every day.

[ WHO WE ARE ][51]

## What we do.

Building on years of experience and hard work, IBP gets the job done.

Every day, our employees across the nation work with builders to meet their installation needs. We
install insulation, rain gutters, garage doors and other products that make a house feel like a
home. And from the first day on the job to the last, IBP leaves no stone unturned, providing
unmatched customer service and quality work in every project we tackle.

[ WHAT WE DO ][52]

#### HARDWARE

## Join our team.

At IBP, we invest in all of our employees. That means robust benefits, a longevity stock program,
and the IBP Foundation, which offers scholarships, emergency assistance and volunteer matching for
everyone in the IBP family.

As a fast-paced, growing company, we’re always on the lookout for dedicated and talented installers
who share our “It’s Hard Work and I Love It” motto to join our team. Are you ready to see what IBP
has to offer?

#### [Do I get a Test Certificate with the electrical insulating mats?][149]

All insulating mats are provided with a Test Certificate against physical properties, chemical

#### [How does Duratuf maintain quality of the electrical rubber mats?][150]

Our insulating mats are manufactured on modern sophisticated plants & machinery. These insulating
mats have outstanding resistance against high temperatures, acids, alkalis, and oils. They are easy
to install and are implemented in front of switchboards, HT and LT panels, transformer rooms, and
near different high-voltage equipment. They are subjected to strict in-process quality checks as per
the various Indian & International Standards to ensure consistent quality.

#### [Why should I use electrical insulating mats?][151]

These insulating mats protect the workers in case of accidental leakage of current while working on
electrical equipment and provide the technicians with added safety and increased productivity.
Electrical insulating mats also exhibit anti-skid properties owing to their corrugated texture. This
enhances the safety of the workers who might be subjected to accidents due to the presence of oil or
greases on the mats. The use of electrical insulating mats not only safeguards the life of your
workers but is also a mandatory requirement by various Safety Audit Agencies as These insulating
mats protect the workers in case of accidental leakage of current while working on electrical
equipment and provide the technicians with added safety and increased productivity. An insulating
mat for electrical purposes offers electrical safety to the workplace by eliminating fatalities
caused due to electric shocks. It is flame retardant for which they can prevent fire outbursts while
operating high voltage equipment. The use of electrical insulating mats not only safeguards the life
of your workers but is also a mandatory requirement by various Safety Audit Agencies such as CPWD &
CENELEC and is recommended for use by international organizations such as IEC, ASTM & BIS.

#### [Which type of insulating mats should I buy in India?][152]

The most recommended mats in India are the Electrical Insulating Mats conforming to IS 15652:2006.
They are approved by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) and carry the ISI Marking on every meter.
Any insulated rubber mat manufacturer in India would recommend the application of IS 15652 to cater
to different industrial needs.  They are acceptable to all safety audits and government agencies.

#### [Which electrical safety mat should I choose for International use?][153]

Mats as per IEC 61111. They are approved by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) &
comply with all CENELEC regulations.

## Industry Challenges & Insights in Insulation Solutions

Industrial and commercial sectors today face mounting pressure to balance operational efficiency
with regulatory and environmental responsibilities. Rising energy costs are driving the need for
better thermal performance, while increasingly stringent fire safety norms demand non-combustible,
compliant materials. At the same time, sustainability goals and green building mandates are
reshaping how insulation is specified and installed. Urban construction also brings the challenge of
acoustic comfort, especially in densely populated environments.

Saint-Gobain’s advanced insulation solutions including Glass Wool and Stone Wool are engineered to
address these evolving challenges. By delivering superior thermal efficiency, fire resistance,
acoustic control, and sustainable performance, our products help businesses optimize energy use,
meet compliance standards, and build for the future with confidence.

## Comprehensive Insulation Solutions for Industrial, Commercial & Residential Needs

Saint-Gobain offers a complete range of high-performance insulation solutions tailored to diverse
applications across India. Our [Glass Wool insulation][23] delivers excellent thermal efficiency,
fire safety, and acoustic comfort—ideal for HVAC systems, partitions, and roofing in commercial and
residential buildings. Rockwool insulation, known for its superior fire resistance, durability, and
sound absorption, is engineered for demanding industrial environments. Whether it's industrial
insulation solutions, commercial insulation applications, or residential insulation systems, our
products are designed to meet evolving energy, safety, and sustainability goals.

## Pioneering Sustainability & Innovation in Insulation Technology

At Saint-Gobain, sustainability is embedded in every stage of our insulation journey—from raw
material sourcing to manufacturing and product lifecycle. Our Glass Wool and Rockwool solutions are
produced using eco-friendly processes and recycled content, helping reduce carbon footprint and
support green building certifications. Backed by global R&D and the legacy of Isover, we continue to
innovate future-ready insulation systems that meet India’s evolving energy efficiency and
environmental standards. Our commitment ensures that every solution contributes to a more
sustainable built environment.

## Why Industry Leaders Trust Saint-Gobain Insulation India

Saint-Gobain Insulation India is backed by the global legacy of Isover, a brand trusted worldwide
since 1937 for its expertise in insulation solutions. Our deep understanding of industrial and
commercial insulation challenges allows us to deliver engineered solutions that meet the highest
standards of performance, safety, and sustainability. With advanced manufacturing facilities in
India and a strong local technical team, we ensure consistent product quality, regulatory
compliance, and responsive customer support.

Our Glass Wool and [Stone Wool Insulation][24] are certified to meet national and international
standards, namely IS 8183, ASTM C 592, IS 9842 , ASTM C 547. These standards include minimum quality
requirements for various parameters such as thermal performance, tolerance limited, fire resistance
(Fire safety) and many more. We work closely with architects, consultants, and project owners to
provide tailored solutions backed by robust R&D and decades of field experience. This combination of
global expertise and local excellence makes Saint-Gobain the trusted insulation partner for industry
leaders across sectors.

# India’s Trusted Insulation Experts

Delivering world-class **thermal** and **acoustic insulation** solutions since 2005 — trusted by
industries, builders, and HVAC professionals across India.

[Explore Products][14]

## Newtech Insulation India

Insulation plays a crucial role in maintaining energy efficiency, thermal stability, sound control,
and safety across residential, commercial, and industrial applications. By reducing heat transfer
and minimizing energy loss, insulation helps lower electricity bills, increases equipment
performance, and improves overall comfort.

At **Newtech Insulation India**, we provide high-quality insulation solutions designed for HVAC
systems, industrial furnaces, acoustic chambers, cold storage, ducting, pipelines, and building
environments. Our products ensure long-term durability, fire resistance, moisture protection, and
compliance with national & international standards.
* Reduces heat loss and improves energy savings
* Provides acoustic control for quieter environments
* Enhances fire safety with non-combustible materials
* Improves performance of HVAC, ducting, and industrial equipment
* Protects surfaces from heat, vibration, and moisture

Whether it's thermal, acoustic, or industrial insulation, we supply reliable solutions that meet
every application need with superior quality and performance.

## Glasswool Insulation Products in India

**Glasswool insulation** is made from fine glass fibers that effectively trap air, providing
exceptional **thermal insulation** and **soundproofing performance**. It is lightweight,
non-combustible, and ideal for **HVAC systems, building ceilings, wall cavities, and industrial
applications**.
* High energy efficiency and temperature control
* Superior acoustic and vibration dampening
* Non-toxic and fire-resistant
* Eco-friendly and recyclable material

[Read More][25]

## Rockwool Mineral Wool Insulation

**Rockwool insulation** (also known as **mineral wool**) is produced from volcanic rock and basalt
fibers. It offers excellent **fire resistance**, **acoustic insulation**, and **thermal stability**,
making it ideal for **industrial plants, refineries, and commercial buildings**.
* Withstands extreme temperatures
* Non-combustible and moisture-resistant
* Excellent for soundproofing walls and ceilings

[Read More][26]

## Ceramic Fiber Insulation Products

**Ceramic fiber insulation** is designed for **high-temperature applications** such as furnaces,
kilns, and boilers. With **low thermal conductivity** and **lightweight composition**, it ensures
energy efficiency and long-term durability.
* Temperature resistance up to 1260°C
* Lightweight and easy to install
* Excellent thermal shock resistance

[Read More][27]

## PTFE Teflon Insulation Materials

**PTFE Teflon insulation** is known for its **non-stick, chemical-resistant, and thermal
stability**. It’s used in **electrical, mechanical, and industrial insulation systems** requiring
high temperature and corrosion resistance.
* Excellent dielectric strength
* Non-reactive and weatherproof
* Ideal for harsh industrial environments

[Read More][28]

## What Is R-Value in Insulation?

R-value measures thermal resistance—the ability of insulation to resist heat flow. The higher the
R-value, the greater the insulating effectiveness. R-value is expressed as h·ft²·°F/BTU in the
United States, representing the temperature difference needed to transfer one BTU of heat per hour
through one square foot of material.

The R-value you need depends on three factors: your climate zone (determined by heating and cooling
degree days), the location being insulated (attic, walls, basement, etc.), and local building codes.
The International Energy Conservation Code (IECC) establishes minimum R-value requirements, though
many energy-conscious homeowners exceed these minimums for better comfort and energy savings.

R-values are additive when materials are layered. For example, R-19 fiberglass batts plus R-11 batts
equals R-30 total. However, compression reduces R-value—a compressed R-19 batt performs below its
rated value. Proper installation without compression, gaps, or voids is essential for achieving
rated performance.

R-per-inch materials achieve the same thermal resistance in less space—critical for walls with
limited cavity depth or cathedral ceilings where every inch matters.

[Complete R-value per inch guide ][18]

## IECC Climate Zones Explained

The United States is divided into 8 climate zones based on heating degree days (HDD) and cooling
degree days (CDD). Your zone determines minimum insulation requirements under the IECC building
code.

Heating-Dominated Zones
Zone 5 (4,500–5,400 HDD)

Denver, Chicago, Boston, Salt Lake City. Cold winters, moderate summers. Attic R-60, wall R-20+5ci
or R-13+10ci.

Zone 6 (5,400–7,200 HDD)

Minneapolis, Milwaukee, Burlington. Very cold winters. Same requirements as Zone 5, but more savings
from exceeding minimums.

Zone 7 (7,200–9,000 HDD)

Duluth, northern New England, northern tier. Severe winters require R-60 attic, R-20+5ci walls, R-38
floors.

Zone 8 (9,000+ HDD)

Alaska only. Extreme cold requires maximum insulation at all envelope locations.

Cooling-Dominated & Mixed Zones
Zone 1 (Very Hot-Humid)

Miami, Key West, Hawaii. Cooling-dominated. R-30 attic minimum, air sealing critical for humidity
control.

Zone 2 (Hot-Humid/Hot-Dry)

Houston, Phoenix, South Florida. R-49 attic, radiant barriers beneficial. Vapor barriers face
exterior.

Zone 3 (Warm)

Atlanta, Dallas, Los Angeles. Mixed heating/cooling. R-49 attic, continuous insulation common on
walls.

Zone 4 (Mixed)

Washington DC, Seattle, St. Louis. R-60 attic required. Marine (4C) subzone has stricter wall
requirements.

[Interactive climate zone map ][19][Find your zone by ZIP code ][20]

─────────────────────────┼────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────┼───

                         │R-3.8       │                                              │0         │   
─────────────────────────┼────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────┼───
Blown-In Fiberglass      │R-2.2 –     │Attic floors, wall retrofits                  │$0.50–$1.0│Yes
                         │R-2.7       │                                              │0         │*  
─────────────────────────┼────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────┼───

                         │R-3.8       │                                              │0         │*  
─────────────────────────┼────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────┼───
Radiant Barrier          │N/A**       │Attic rafters (hot climates only)             │$0.15–$0.5│Yes
                         │            │                                              │0         │

*Blower machine rental available at home improvement stores. **Radiant barriers reduce radiant heat
transfer; they don't have an R-value but can reduce cooling loads by 5–10% in hot climates.

[View complete R-value chart with all materials ][14]

## 2021 IECC Insulation Requirements by Climate Zone

The International Energy Conservation Code (IECC) establishes minimum R-value requirements based on
climate zone. These are legal minimums—exceeding them improves energy efficiency and comfort. Use
our [R-Value Calculator][15] to find your zone by ZIP code.

──────────────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────────────┬─────┬──────────────┬──────────────
Zone                  │Ceiling/Attic│Wood Frame Wall      │Floor│Basement Wall │Crawl Space   
──────────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────┼─────┼──────────────┼──────────────
Zone 1                │R-30         │R-13                 │R-13 │NR            │NR            
──────────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────┼─────┼──────────────┼──────────────
Zone 2                │R-49         │R-13                 │R-13 │NR            │NR            
──────────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────┼─────┼──────────────┼──────────────
Zone 3                │R-49         │R-20 or R-13+5ci     │R-19 │R-5ci or R-13 │R-5ci or R-13 
──────────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────┼─────┼──────────────┼──────────────
Zone 4 (except Marine)│R-60         │R-20 or R-13+5ci     │R-19 │R-10ci or R-13│R-10ci or R-13
──────────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────┼─────┼──────────────┼──────────────
Zone 4 Marine         │R-60         │R-20+5ci or R-13+10ci│R-30 │R-10ci or R-13│R-10ci or R-13
──────────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────┼─────┼──────────────┼──────────────
Zone 5                │R-60         │R-20+5ci or R-13+10ci│R-30 │R-15ci or R-19│R-15ci or R-19
──────────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────┼─────┼──────────────┼──────────────
Zone 6                │R-60         │R-20+5ci or R-13+10ci│R-30 │R-15ci or R-19│R-15ci or R-19
──────────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────┼─────┼──────────────┼──────────────
Zone 7                │R-60         │R-20+5ci or R-13+10ci│R-38 │R-15ci or R-19│R-15ci or R-19
──────────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────┼─────┼──────────────┼──────────────
Zone 8                │R-60         │R-20+5ci or R-13+10ci│R-38 │R-15ci or R-19│R-15ci or R-19
──────────────────────┴─────────────┴─────────────────────┴─────┴──────────────┴──────────────

"ci" = continuous insulation (uninterrupted by framing). R-13+5ci means R-13 cavity insulation plus
R-5 continuous exterior insulation. "NR" = Not Required by code. Source: 2021 IECC Table R402.1.3
(residential prescriptive R-values), last verified May 2026. Local codes may differ—always verify
with your building department.

[Find requirements for your ZIP code ][16][View climate zone map ][17]

## R-Value Per Inch Comparison

R-value per inch determines how much thickness you need to achieve your target R-value. Higher
R-per-inch materials achieve the same thermal resistance in less space—critical for walls with
limited cavity depth or cathedral ceilings where every inch matters.

### Highest R-Value Per Inch

──────────────────────────┬──────
Material                  │R/Inch
──────────────────────────┼──────
Closed-Cell Spray Foam    │R-6.5 
──────────────────────────┼──────
Polyisocyanurate          │R-6.0 
──────────────────────────┼──────
Extruded Polystyrene (XPS)│R-5.0 
──────────────────────────┼──────
Expanded Polystyrene (EPS)│R-4.0 
──────────────────────────┼──────
High-Density Fiberglass   │R-3.8 
──────────────────────────┴──────

### Standard R-Value Per Inch

────────────────────┬──────
Material            │R/Inch
────────────────────┼──────
Open-Cell Spray Foam│R-3.7 
────────────────────┼──────
Cellulose (Blown)   │R-3.5 
────────────────────┼──────
Mineral Wool Batts  │R-3.3 
────────────────────┼──────
Fiberglass Batts    │R-3.2 
────────────────────┼──────
Blown-In Fiberglass │R-2.5 
────────────────────┴──────

#### Thickness Required for R-49 Attic Insulation

Closed-Cell Foam7.5 inches
Cellulose14 inches
Fiberglass Batts15.5 inches
Blown Fiberglass19.5 inches
[Complete R-value per inch guide ][18]

## IECC Climate Zones Explained

The United States is divided into 8 climate zones based on heating degree days (HDD) and cooling
degree days (CDD). Your zone determines minimum insulation requirements under the IECC building
code.

Heating-Dominated Zones
Zone 5 (4,500–5,400 HDD)

Denver, Chicago, Boston, Salt Lake City. Cold winters, moderate summers. Attic R-60, wall R-20+5ci
or R-13+10ci.

Zone 6 (5,400–7,200 HDD)

Minneapolis, Milwaukee, Burlington. Very cold winters. Same requirements as Zone 5, but more savings
from exceeding minimums.

Zone 7 (7,200–9,000 HDD)

Duluth, northern New England, northern tier. Severe winters require R-60 attic, R-20+5ci walls, R-38
floors.

Zone 8 (9,000+ HDD)

Alaska only. Extreme cold requires maximum insulation at all envelope locations.

Cooling-Dominated & Mixed Zones
Zone 1 (Very Hot-Humid)

Miami, Key West, Hawaii. Cooling-dominated. R-30 attic minimum, air sealing critical for humidity
control.

Zone 2 (Hot-Humid/Hot-Dry)

Houston, Phoenix, South Florida. R-49 attic, radiant barriers beneficial. Vapor barriers face
exterior.

Zone 3 (Warm)

Atlanta, Dallas, Los Angeles. Mixed heating/cooling. R-49 attic, continuous insulation common on
walls.

Zone 4 (Mixed)

Washington DC, Seattle, St. Louis. R-60 attic required. Marine (4C) subzone has stricter wall
requirements.

[Interactive climate zone map ][19][Find your zone by ZIP code ][20]

Insulation costs vary by material, installation method (DIY vs. professional), and project scope.
These are 2025-2026 national average costs including materials and labor where applicable.

THE INSULATOR EDUCATION INITIATIVE

### **BETTER INSULATOR DECISIONS START WITH BETTER INFORMATION**

As grid demands grow and conditions get tougher, choosing the right insulator is more critical than
ever.

The **Insulator Education Initiative** delivers clear, practical resources to help technical teams
make informed, confident decisions.

From comparison tables and explainer videos to technical articles and online tools, our content is
built to support engineers, buyers, and specifiers at every stage.

[ Visit Hub ][13]

Who we are

## Insulation Technology Group

**Insulation Technology Group** is an experienced international holding company operating in the
market segments of manufacturing **HV and MV electrical porcelain insulators**.

The corporation includes three major global brands **[LAPP Insulators][14], [PPC
Insulators][15], **and[** Cerisol**][16], produced in 8 manufacturing plants in Europe and North and
South America.

Our focus on the customer´s goals and the ability to provide both tailor-made insulation solutions
and standardized ones, with our engineering and technical support, makes us the preferred choice
when utilities, distributors, and contractors want to have a reliable insulator partner.

Sustainability is one of our key values that drives the design of our products, manufacturing, and
full supply chain processes.

[ Learn more ][17]
[INSULATION TECHNOLOGY GROUP - manufacture HV and MV electrical porcelain insulators]
[insulationtg Sustainability - Porcelain insulators]

### **Environmental responsibility**

ITG aimes to be a forerunner in the circular economy with **recyclable products and sustainable
manufacturing**.

**Porcelain insulators** are a very green option.

They are produced from the green and natural local raw materials.

They have a very long lifetime.

They are produced with 100% recyclability with low carbon  footprint and without hazards after the
end of life.

[INSULATION TECHNOLOGY GROUP - manufacture HV and MV electrical porcelain insulators]

## CONTACT US

In case of any questions or incentives regarding compliance, please contact us at the following
email address [compliance@insulationtg.com][18] or send us your message via the contact form.

# Olemme avoinna palvelemassa rakennusprojektejanne!

# PROFIILI

**I**solina yhtiöt kehittää, valmistaa ja markkinoi pellavapohjaisia tuotteita.
Pellavakuitu sisältää ominaisuuksia, jotka tekevät siitä ihanteellisen raaka-aineen
eristysmateriaalina:
se hengittää, absorboi ja luovuttaa liiallista kosteutta.

**P**ellavaa on käytetty tekstiilikuituna tuhansia vuosia. Vanhin pellavaharsolöytö on tehty
Egyptissä
7000 vuotta sitten.
On olemassa noin 200 eri pellavalajia. Lehdet ovat ohuita, kukat sinisiä, punaisia, valkoisia tai
keltaisia. Kauniista sinisistä pelloista, jotka auttavat pitämään maisemat avoinna, syntyy tehokasta
lämmöneristettä taloihimme.

**P**äätuotteitamme ovat monenlaiset lämmön- ja ääneneristeet.

**T**uotteemme ovat pellavapohjaisia, joiden valmistus pohjautuu ympäristötietoiseen ajatteluun.

[ISOLINA linen insulation; pellevaeriste; nauhat; linisolering; linull; drev; linisolasjon;
laftevatt]

# EDUT
1. hengittävät rakenteet
2. luonnonkuitu: luontaisetu
3. parempi sisäilman laatu
4. kestävä rakenne

**A**ikaisemmin talot olivat heikosti eristettyjä, mutta ne hengittivät.
Tällöin energiaa hukattiin paljon, mutta sisäilman laatu oli monissa tapauksissa parempi kuin
nykyisin.
Nykyiset talot rakennetaan yleensä hyvin eristettyinä, mutta muovisten höyrynsulkukalvojen ja
puutteellisen ilmanvaihdon yhteisvaikutuksesta sisäilman laatu heikkenee. Lisäksi rakenteisiin,
tavalla tai toisella, päässyt kosteus aiheuttaa riskin kosteusvauriolle ja rakenteiden
vaurioitumiselle.

**P**ellavaeriste tarjoaa molempien aikakausien hyvät ominaisuudet:
hyvän lämmön- ja ääneneristyksen, yhdistettynä pellavakuidulle ominaiseen kosteuden hengityskykyyn
seinä- ja kattorakenteissa, mahdollistaen rakenteiden hengittävyyden kastumatta.

# PROFIILI

**I**solina yhtiöt kehittää, valmistaa ja markkinoi pellavapohjaisia tuotteita.
Pellavakuitu sisältää ominaisuuksia, jotka tekevät siitä ihanteellisen raaka-aineen
eristysmateriaalina:
se hengittää, absorboi ja luovuttaa liiallista kosteutta.

**P**ellavaa on käytetty tekstiilikuituna tuhansia vuosia. Vanhin pellavaharsolöytö on tehty
Egyptissä
7000 vuotta sitten.
On olemassa noin 200 eri pellavalajia. Lehdet ovat ohuita, kukat sinisiä, punaisia, valkoisia tai
keltaisia. Kauniista sinisistä pelloista, jotka auttavat pitämään maisemat avoinna, syntyy tehokasta
lämmöneristettä taloihimme.

**P**äätuotteitamme ovat monenlaiset lämmön- ja ääneneristeet.

[ISOLINA linen insulation; pellevaeriste; nauhat; linisolering; linull; drev; linisolasjon;
laftevatt]

# EDUT
1. hengittävät rakenteet
2. luonnonkuitu: luontaisetu
3. parempi sisäilman laatu
4. kestävä rakenne

**A**ikaisemmin talot olivat heikosti eristettyjä, mutta ne hengittivät.
Tällöin energiaa hukattiin paljon, mutta sisäilman laatu oli monissa tapauksissa parempi kuin
nykyisin.
Nykyiset talot rakennetaan yleensä hyvin eristettyinä, mutta muovisten höyrynsulkukalvojen ja
puutteellisen ilmanvaihdon yhteisvaikutuksesta sisäilman laatu heikkenee. Lisäksi rakenteisiin,
tavalla tai toisella, päässyt kosteus aiheuttaa riskin kosteusvauriolle ja rakenteiden
vaurioitumiselle.

**P**ellavaeriste tarjoaa molempien aikakausien hyvät ominaisuudet:
hyvän lämmön- ja ääneneristyksen, yhdistettynä pellavakuidulle ominaiseen kosteuden hengityskykyyn
seinä- ja kattorakenteissa, mahdollistaen rakenteiden hengittävyyden kastumatta.

Application: HVAC
QUICK WORK OF DUCT WORK
HVAC systems are used in both commercial and residential buildings — from offices to factories,
hotels to homes. Adding HVAC insulation can help improve overall comfort and even lead to lower
utility costs.
[ Learn More ][134]
Application: Pipes
BETTER PROCESS CONTROL
Proper performance and safety are top of mind when it comes to pipe insulation. Installing it can
lead to more effective operation, reduce overall operating costs and even provide protection.
[ Learn More ][135]
Application: Attics
Step Up to the Attic
Attics — one of the most popular home-improvement projects for both DIYers and professional
contractors. Adding insulation to the attic is an easy and proven way to increase home comfort and
decrease energy costs.
[ Learn More ][136]
Application: Ceiling
Above Your Head
Whether it’s in your home or a commercial building, ceiling insulation can create a more comfortable
environment. It delivers excellent noise control, as well as thermal resistance that could help save
on heating and cooling bills.
[ Learn More ][137]
Application: Walls
The Walls Around Us
Increase the overall comfort of your home with wall insulation. It can reduce room-to-room sound
transmission. Thanks to the insulation's thermal performance, temperatures are maintained, reducing
energy loss and energy costs.
[ Learn More ][138]
Application: Mid-Floor
Just Between Us
Mid-floor insulation will help you meet the NFPA13 fire code. By properly insulating between floors
with a non-combustible material, your space won’t require a sprinkler system.
[ Learn More ][139]
Application: Floor
A Strong Foundation
There’s often noise associated with floors above another living area. Floor insulation can help
minimize that noise transfer. Beyond sound control, it even offers thermal performance.
[ Learn More ][140]
Application: Basement & Crawlspace
From the Bottom, Up
The basement — typically known for being a cold space. But with the proper insulation, all that can
change. Basement insulation can actually improve indoor home comfort and even save you money on
energy costs.
[ Learn More ][141]
Application: Air Sealing
Seal it Up
Leaks and drafts can make your home atmosphere a miserable one. Filling voids and cracks where air
can leak into your home can increase home comfort, decrease energy costs and make for a healthier
indoor structure.
[ Learn More ][142]
Application: High Temperature Equipment
It’s Heating Up
If you work with equipment like vessels, boilers or industrial ovens, you know the appliance and the
area around it can get hot. That’s why proper performance and safety are top of mind when it comes
to elevated temperature insulation.
[ Learn More ][143]
Application: Metal Building
More Comfortable Environment
When it comes to metal buildings, insulation is crucial. For overall indoor comfort, metal building
insulation will help maintain temperatures, control sound and even provide energy savings.
[ Learn More ][144]
Application: Filtration
Filter Through
When dealing with natural gas and liquids, you need a material that can withstand the dirt and
corrosiveness. Fiberglass is a trusted filter media across a wide array of industries.
[ Learn More ][145]
Application: Sound Control
Peace & Quiet
Excessive noise can be distracting and affect the overall comfort of our environment. With the right
insulation, you can reduce unwanted noise from getting in and limit the amount of noise transferring
out.
[ Learn More ][146]

## For Spaces that Matter

Every building serves a purpose. That’s why insulation is designed with purpose. From the places you
live to the places you work, and all the spaces in between. See how insulation can make an impact on
a building and the people within it.
