Application: HVAC
QUICK WORK OF DUCT WORK
HVAC systems are used in both commercial and residential buildings — from offices to factories,
hotels to homes. Adding HVAC insulation can help improve overall comfort and even lead to lower
utility costs.
[ Learn More ][134]
Application: Pipes
BETTER PROCESS CONTROL
Proper performance and safety are top of mind when it comes to pipe insulation. Installing it can
lead to more effective operation, reduce overall operating costs and even provide protection.
[ Learn More ][135]
Application: Attics
Step Up to the Attic
Attics — one of the most popular home-improvement projects for both DIYers and professional
contractors. Adding insulation to the attic is an easy and proven way to increase home comfort and
decrease energy costs.
[ Learn More ][136]
Application: Ceiling
Above Your Head
Whether it’s in your home or a commercial building, ceiling insulation can create a more comfortable
environment. It delivers excellent noise control, as well as thermal resistance that could help save
on heating and cooling bills.
[ Learn More ][137]
Application: Walls
The Walls Around Us
Increase the overall comfort of your home with wall insulation. It can reduce room-to-room sound
transmission. Thanks to the insulation's thermal performance, temperatures are maintained, reducing
energy loss and energy costs.
[ Learn More ][138]
Application: Mid-Floor
Just Between Us
Mid-floor insulation will help you meet the NFPA13 fire code. By properly insulating between floors
with a non-combustible material, your space won’t require a sprinkler system.
[ Learn More ][139]
Application: Floor
A Strong Foundation
There’s often noise associated with floors above another living area. Floor insulation can help
minimize that noise transfer. Beyond sound control, it even offers thermal performance.
[ Learn More ][140]
Application: Basement & Crawlspace
From the Bottom, Up
The basement — typically known for being a cold space. But with the proper insulation, all that can
change. Basement insulation can actually improve indoor home comfort and even save you money on
energy costs.
[ Learn More ][141]
Application: Air Sealing
Seal it Up
Leaks and drafts can make your home atmosphere a miserable one. Filling voids and cracks where air
can leak into your home can increase home comfort, decrease energy costs and make for a healthier
indoor structure.
[ Learn More ][142]
Application: High Temperature Equipment
It’s Heating Up
If you work with equipment like vessels, boilers or industrial ovens, you know the appliance and the
area around it can get hot. That’s why proper performance and safety are top of mind when it comes
to elevated temperature insulation.
[ Learn More ][143]
Application: Metal Building
More Comfortable Environment
When it comes to metal buildings, insulation is crucial. For overall indoor comfort, metal building
insulation will help maintain temperatures, control sound and even provide energy savings.
[ Learn More ][144]
Application: Filtration
Filter Through
When dealing with natural gas and liquids, you need a material that can withstand the dirt and
corrosiveness. Fiberglass is a trusted filter media across a wide array of industries.
[ Learn More ][145]
Application: Sound Control
Peace & Quiet
Excessive noise can be distracting and affect the overall comfort of our environment. With the right
insulation, you can reduce unwanted noise from getting in and limit the amount of noise transferring
out.
[ Learn More ][146]

Every building serves a purpose. That’s why insulation is designed with purpose. From the places you
live to the places you work, and all the spaces in between. See how insulation can make an impact on

heat are going right out the door along with your money spent on energy bills. Proper insulation of
your home’s attic and floors can reduce your monthly energy expenses by 15% on average. We make your
home energy efficient, which is great for your comfortability and the environment!

[Professional insulation installation service for residential or commercial property improvement.]

achieve comfort!

Why Choose Mooney & Moses Contractors?

At Mooney & Moses, **integrity, expertise, and exceptional service** are more than just
promises—they define how we work. Whether you're a homeowner seeking energy-efficient solutions or a
builder looking for reliable installations, our team delivers **high-quality products and unmatched
craftsmanship** you can trust.


**Comprehensive Home Solutions**
Looking to improve your home's **comfort, efficiency, and curb appeal**? We specialize in**
professional insulation installation, durable garage doors, and reliable gutter systems,** tailored
to meet your needs. From reducing energy costs to enhancing your home’s aesthetics, Mooney & Moses
is your** trusted partner for home improvement.**

# Insulation Contractors Serving Cincinnati, Ohio

Mooney & Moses has been serving the Cincinnati area with a high-quality level of installed products
and services since 1949. Mooney & Moses knows that a job is only as good as the crew that does it,
and that’s what makes us different—attention to detail, technical expertise and a commitment to
quality.

Whether you need [home insulation][64], [commercial insulation][65] or anything in between, we seek
your satisfaction and take our customer relationships very seriously.

## Professional Insulation Contractors Offering Top-Quality Insulation Materials

No matter what your home or commercial insulation needs are, Mooney & Moses has you covered. We
offer different types of insulation for new construction and retrofit projects, including:
* [Fiberglass][66]
* [Cellulose][67]
* [Spray foam][68]
* [Radiant barrier][69]
* [Rigid board foam][70]
* [Vinyl ][71]

In addition to the highest-quality insulation products, Mooney & Moses offers excellent customer
service. If you’re looking for a great insulation company in Cincinnati, don’t hesitate to give us a
call!

## Residential Insulation for New Construction & Retrofit Projects

Are your energy bills higher than normal? We have found that insulation is one of the best ways to
increase the energy efficiency and comfort of Cincinnati homes all year long. Our team can also
insulate many different spaces of your Cincinnati home, including:
* [Attic][72]
* [Basement][73]
* [Crawl space][74]
* [Floors][75]
* [Garage][76]
* [Walls][77]

## Commercial Insulation

Mooney & Moses has worked with many local builders, contractors and remodelers on new building
construction and addition projects. We have experience insulating different types of commercial
buildings, including:
* [Industrial construction][78]
* [Metal buildings][79]
* [Warehouses][80]

Re-insulating your business or office space can help decrease overhead costs and keep workers more
comfortable. Our team can help you determine which type of insulation is needed.

to meet your needs. From reducing energy costs to enhancing your home’s aesthetics, Mooney & Moses
is your** trusted partner for home improvement.**

# Insulation Contractors Serving Cincinnati, Ohio

Mooney & Moses has been serving the Cincinnati area with a high-quality level of installed products
and services since 1949. Mooney & Moses knows that a job is only as good as the crew that does it,
and that’s what makes us different—attention to detail, technical expertise and a commitment to
quality.

Whether you need [home insulation][64], [commercial insulation][65] or anything in between, we seek
your satisfaction and take our customer relationships very seriously.

## Professional Insulation Contractors Offering Top-Quality Insulation Materials

No matter what your home or commercial insulation needs are, Mooney & Moses has you covered. We
offer different types of insulation for new construction and retrofit projects, including:
* [Fiberglass][66]
* [Cellulose][67]
* [Spray foam][68]
* [Radiant barrier][69]
* [Rigid board foam][70]
* [Vinyl ][71]

In addition to the highest-quality insulation products, Mooney & Moses offers excellent customer
service. If you’re looking for a great insulation company in Cincinnati, don’t hesitate to give us a
call!

## Residential Insulation for New Construction & Retrofit Projects

Are your energy bills higher than normal? We have found that insulation is one of the best ways to
increase the energy efficiency and comfort of Cincinnati homes all year long. Our team can also
insulate many different spaces of your Cincinnati home, including:

## Commercial Insulation

construction and addition projects. We have experience insulating different types of commercial
buildings, including:
* [Industrial construction][78]

comfortable. Our team can help you determine which type of insulation is needed.

# Smart Research

North Data provides easily understandable company information that is publicly available, obtained
from sources such as trade registers, yearly reports, funding registers, trademark registers, patent
registers and others.

### For Professionals

North Data’s [Premium Services][22] are used by professionals, from all sectors, for detailed
research and financial analyses. Our powerful [Data Services][23] are used by our customers to
expand their databases and complement their products with meaningful company information and
visualizations.

### For Everybody

North Data's free online search engine offers a powerful freely accessible compilation of
[European][24] companies information, including history, financial indicators, involved persons, and
much more. Use the search box at the top of this page to specifically search for companies or
people.

[Country Coverage][25]

### New Countries and Sources

At North Data, we continuously work on adding new countries and sources to our data. Recently, we
added **Portugal**, **Ireland**, and the **Netherlands** to our list of supported countries.
Currently, we're working on more countries, and deepening the data coverage for the existing ones.

# Smart Research

North Data provides easily understandable company information that is publicly available, obtained
from sources such as trade registers, yearly reports, funding registers, trademark registers, patent
registers and others.

### For Professionals

North Data’s [Premium Services][22] are used by professionals, from all sectors, for detailed
research and financial analyses. Our powerful [Data Services][23] are used by our customers to
expand their databases and complement their products with meaningful company information and
visualizations.

### For Everybody

North Data's free online search engine offers a powerful freely accessible compilation of
[European][24] companies information, including history, financial indicators, involved persons, and
much more. Use the search box at the top of this page to specifically search for companies or
people.

[Country Coverage][25]

### New Countries and Sources

At North Data, we continuously work on adding new countries and sources to our data. Recently, we
added **Portugal**, **Ireland**, and the **Netherlands** to our list of supported countries.
Currently, we're working on more countries, and deepening the data coverage for the existing ones.

## Quick Answersfor You

Quick answers to your pressing questions.

## [Q: Are you a trader or manufacturer?][50] 

A: We are a manufacturer of composite insulating papers (DMD, NMN, AMA etc) and insulating sleeves,
with our own factory and production lines. At the same time, we have established strong strategic
partnerships with other material manufacturers, enabling us to act as your one-stop sourcing
consultant, efficiently meeting your diverse product needs.

## [Q: How about MOQ?][51] 

A: The standard minimum order quantity(MOQ) is usually 100~1000kg, also depends on products. For
customized products, the specific quantity can be negotiated.

## [Q: What are the lead time, packing method, shipping options, and after-sales solution for
## quality issues?][52] 

A: Lead time and shipping method depend on product type, quantity, processing requirements, and
destination. Normally 7~30 days. Standard materials usually have a shorter lead time, while
customized machined parts or bulk orders require a longer production period. For packing, we use
moisture-proof, pressure-resistant, and packaging according to product characteristics, such as
pallets.

## [Q: Can you provide samples for testing?][53] 

A: Yes. We are happy to provide free samples to potential customers with specific project needs.
Please tell us your specific application and testing requirements so that we can recommend the most
suitable model and arrange for sample delivery.

## [Q: What international certifications does your insulating paper have?][54] 

A: Our products comply with IEC standards and can also provide RoHS environmental certification
reports upon customer request. All certification certificates are available upon request.

## Quick Answersfor You

Quick answers to your pressing questions.

## [Q: Are you a trader or manufacturer?][50] 

A: We are a manufacturer of composite insulating papers (DMD, NMN, AMA etc) and insulating sleeves,
with our own factory and production lines. At the same time, we have established strong strategic
partnerships with other material manufacturers, enabling us to act as your one-stop sourcing
consultant, efficiently meeting your diverse product needs.

## [Q: How about MOQ?][51] 

A: The standard minimum order quantity(MOQ) is usually 100~1000kg, also depends on products. For
customized products, the specific quantity can be negotiated.

## [Q: What are the lead time, packing method, shipping options, and after-sales solution for
## quality issues?][52] 

A: Lead time and shipping method depend on product type, quantity, processing requirements, and
destination. Normally 7~30 days. Standard materials usually have a shorter lead time, while
customized machined parts or bulk orders require a longer production period. For packing, we use
moisture-proof, pressure-resistant, and packaging according to product characteristics, such as
pallets.

## [Q: Can you provide samples for testing?][53] 

A: Yes. We are happy to provide free samples to potential customers with specific project needs.
Please tell us your specific application and testing requirements so that we can recommend the most
suitable model and arrange for sample delivery.

## [Q: What international certifications does your insulating paper have?][54] 

A: Our products comply with IEC standards and can also provide RoHS environmental certification
reports upon customer request. All certification certificates are available upon request.

## *bringing the best quality*
## *mineral wool to your projects*

# FIRE, SOUND AND THERMAL INSULATION

# GREAT THERMAL INSULATION PROPERTIES

Also known as mineral wool, stone wool is created by spinning molten rock and minerals with steel
slag to create a cotton-candy-like wool product. Pressed into rolls and sheets, stone wool creates
an incredibly effective insulation with sound-absorbing and fire-resistant properties.

### It’s Efficient

STONE WOOL products derive their thermal properties from tiny pockets of air trapped within the
physical structures of the stone wool. This structure allows the insulation to keep hot air out in
hot climates and retain warmth in cold climates.

### It’s Safer

Stone wool is resistant to fire. So if a fire starts, it will delay the spread—giving you and your
family more time to escape.

### It’s Quieter

STONE WOOL is high-density and excellent at absorbing sound.

### It’s Moisture Repellent

STONE WOOL insulation naturally repels water and moisture, so the long-term thermal performance of
the insulation is not affected by water.

[lana-home-1]

# POLISH
# STONE WOOL
# GROUP

#### Professional

# STONE WOOL CUTTER

**.**

**Cutting size:** 1350×200

**Materials:** fleece insulation, mineral wool, fiber boards, phenolic, polyurethane foam.
Possibility to use from right side and left side.

**Cuts** from 0° to 60°

[aerogel]

# AEROGEL PANEL

### Thermal conductivity 0,015 W/mK

Panel designed for thermal insulation of those building structures that require the highest degree
of insulation in the smallest possible space.

It is made of a nanotechnological Aerogel insulator coupled with a breathable polypropylene membrane
reinforced with glass fiber and is designed for the realization of low thickness thermal insulation.
With a thickness of 10 mm – and a thermal conductivity equal to 0.015 W / mK – the Aerogel Panel
reduces energy dispersion saves space in civil, commercial and residential buildings.

## MINIMUM SPACE
## MAXIMUM ISULATION

## **Ideal for historical buildings**

Aeropan® is the perfect choice for outdoor and indoor restructuring, as well as building recovery
and historical buildings subject to architectural restraints which require top levels of living
comfort.

## *mineral wool to your projects*

# FIRE, SOUND AND THERMAL INSULATION

# GREAT THERMAL INSULATION PROPERTIES

Also known as mineral wool, stone wool is created by spinning molten rock and minerals with steel
slag to create a cotton-candy-like wool product. Pressed into rolls and sheets, stone wool creates
an incredibly effective insulation with sound-absorbing and fire-resistant properties.

### It’s Efficient

STONE WOOL products derive their thermal properties from tiny pockets of air trapped within the
physical structures of the stone wool. This structure allows the insulation to keep hot air out in
hot climates and retain warmth in cold climates.

### It’s Safer

Stone wool is resistant to fire. So if a fire starts, it will delay the spread—giving you and your
family more time to escape.

### It’s Quieter

STONE WOOL is high-density and excellent at absorbing sound.

### It’s Moisture Repellent

STONE WOOL insulation naturally repels water and moisture, so the long-term thermal performance of
the insulation is not affected by water.

# AEROGEL PANEL

### Thermal conductivity 0,015 W/mK

Panel designed for thermal insulation of those building structures that require the highest degree
of insulation in the smallest possible space.

It is made of a nanotechnological Aerogel insulator coupled with a breathable polypropylene membrane
reinforced with glass fiber and is designed for the realization of low thickness thermal insulation.
With a thickness of 10 mm – and a thermal conductivity equal to 0.015 W / mK – the Aerogel Panel
reduces energy dispersion saves space in civil, commercial and residential buildings.

## Informazioni su FELIS

Produzione di tutti i tipi di prodotti in PTFE vergine **dal 1998**. Precisione e tecnologia
italiana ai prezzi più bassi d’Europa. I nostri prodotti in PTFE sono stati venduti e spediti in
oltre 20 paesi in tutto il mondo. Qualità garantita dalle principali certificazioni (come ISO 9001 –
conformità 2.1 – 2.2 – 3.1 – FDA – RoHS).

## Origini e primi sviluppi dal 1998

[lastre ptfe tondi ptfe nastro in ptfe guarnizioni in ptfe]

FELIS SRL Unipersonale è stata fondata nel 1998 dopo una lunga esperienza nel settore del PTFE
(Teflon) – un materiale difficile da lavorare e la cui tecnologia è padroneggiata solo da poche
aziende al mondo. Dopo approfonditi studi e formazione negli Stati Uniti e in Russia, FELIS SRL ha
acquisito il know-how necessario per entrare a far parte del ristretto gruppo di aziende produttrici
di PTFE. Sfruttando questa tecnologia ed esperienza, l’azienda ha iniziato a produrre PTFE sia sotto
forma di semilavorati che di prodotti finiti.

## Crescita, leadership e innovazione

Negli anni, FELIS SRL è diventata un punto di riferimento in Europa grazie alla sua gamma completa
di prodotti di alta qualità, ai prezzi competitivi, alla disponibilità immediata a magazzino e a una
rete logistica efficiente. Il continuo progresso tecnologico e le partnership strategiche di
know-how hanno posizionato FELIS SRL tra le poche aziende in Europa in grado di gestire l’intera
filiera produttiva del PTFE, offrendo un portafoglio di prodotti tra i più competitivi nel mercato
globale.

[Crescita, leadership e innovazione]

## Informazioni su FELIS

Produzione di tutti i tipi di prodotti in PTFE vergine **dal 1998**. Precisione e tecnologia
italiana ai prezzi più bassi d’Europa. I nostri prodotti in PTFE sono stati venduti e spediti in

## Origini e primi sviluppi dal 1998

[lastre ptfe tondi ptfe nastro in ptfe guarnizioni in ptfe]

FELIS SRL Unipersonale è stata fondata nel 1998 dopo una lunga esperienza nel settore del PTFE
(Teflon) – un materiale difficile da lavorare e la cui tecnologia è padroneggiata solo da poche
aziende al mondo. Dopo approfonditi studi e formazione negli Stati Uniti e in Russia, FELIS SRL ha
acquisito il know-how necessario per entrare a far parte del ristretto gruppo di aziende produttrici
di PTFE. Sfruttando questa tecnologia ed esperienza, l’azienda ha iniziato a produrre PTFE sia sotto
forma di semilavorati che di prodotti finiti.

## Crescita, leadership e innovazione

Negli anni, FELIS SRL è diventata un punto di riferimento in Europa grazie alla sua gamma completa
di prodotti di alta qualità, ai prezzi competitivi, alla disponibilità immediata a magazzino e a una
rete logistica efficiente. Il continuo progresso tecnologico e le partnership strategiche di
know-how hanno posizionato FELIS SRL tra le poche aziende in Europa in grado di gestire l’intera
filiera produttiva del PTFE, offrendo un portafoglio di prodotti tra i più competitivi nel mercato
globale.

bank account number? In response to the increasing phishing attempts worldwide, we are now providing

the bank account number is linked to a genuine Recticel bank account.

## About Us

Register Insulation, Inc. was founded in 1983 by Keith Register. His dream of having his own
business, coupled with his hard work ethic and a principle to always "do the job right", has turned
Register Insulation, Inc. into a thriving company for 40 years! This reality continues now with his
son, Chris Register, as the V.P. of Register Insulation, Inc. Our team has more than 65 full time
employees and our team of seasoned estimators and quality installers are here to tackle any job big
or small.

[IMG_2848.jpg]

## Services Provided

What We Can Do For You

[IMG_6752.jpg]

### Renovation

Our team works closely with each client to make sure we’re meeting, and exceeding expectations. Get
in touch for more information.

[IMG_3708.jpg]

### New Construction

Register Insulation, Inc. has loads of experience with this service, using respected equipment
brands and trusted material providers. We offer professional and experienced help with your
projects, helping to match your unique needs and budget. We strive to provide great customer service
and clear communication so you can understand the progress of your job at every phase.

[IMG_4120.HEIC]

### Repair

We understand the importance of picking the right company that’s experienced and dependable. We have
the tools and knowledge to get the job done right with the highest standards and at the best price.
Let us know how we can help with your needs.

or small.

# What We Offer

#### Heat & Ventilation

RK Insulation provides a complete service of design, manufacture and installation of insulation,
cladding, process heating and vents using highly experienced thermal insulation, mechanical and
electrical engineers.

#### Chilled Services

RK Insulation can oversee your cold room/store project through initial concept, design, erection of
the insulated cladding structure, installation of refrigeration systems and maintenance. RK
Insulation specializes in undertaking large cold rooms, cold stores, chilled storage & refrigerated
warehouse projects across India.

#### Frost Protection

Thermal Insulation can be used as a primary frost protection system for pipe work or vessels for
industrial use. We offer weatherproof finishes for external applications and can manufacture various
metal cladding for pipework and fittings.

#### Rigid Foam Insulation

RK Insulation installs rigid foam insulation for a variety of applications, including the attic,
basement and crawl space. Rigid foam is a popular insulating product for its durability, high
insulating value and versatility.

#### Dehumidification

RK Insulation industrial dryers operate reliably, thus preventing condensation, odor nuisance and
the spread of germs – the perfect humidity control essential for food industry. Protective clothing,
disinfection, compliance with the cold chain and other strict hygienic requirements are on the
agenda in the processing of fresh produce.

#### Acoustic Insulation

RK Insulation provides soundproofing consulting services designed around the full array of
acoustical sound panels and related soundproofing products you will discover right here on our
website. We start with the advice, then package the framework for your treatment around your budget,
and deliver the most cost effective soundproofing products on the market to your doorstep.

#### Noise Protection

RK Insulation has considerable expertise in designing acoustic insulation for a industrial/
shipping/ commercial infrastructures. Using structural drawings, engine characteristics and other
data, we can calculate and manufacture all the necessary noise protection, such as silencers and
sound-absorbing systems.

#### Blown in Insulation

As part of our installation service for attic insulation in India and surrounding areas, our
professionals will work with you to determine if blown insulation is the right insulation for your
home or project, and what the appropriate R-value for the property should be.

#### Cellulose Insulation

RK Insulation provides superb energy savings along with a significant reduction in air infiltration,
resulting in outstanding long-term value and return on investment. RK’ Cellulose Insulation is also
made of up to 85% Indian recycled materials, making RK one of the greenest insulations.

#### Steel & Condensate Pipework

RK Insulation undertakes insulation of pipe and duct systems to avoid condensation or to provide
personnel protection is required. We do Insulation of the complete system, which is required when
condensation is possible.

#### Refractory Lining

RK Insulation undertakes designing, supply, and installation of any type of refractory lining
required for power plants, petrochemicals and chemical units. Also, we undertake, vibro casting of
reactor, regenerator package including supply and installation.

#### Passive Fire Protection

RK Insulation’s undertake designing and manufacturing flexible passive fire protection systems to
fit the equipment’s/ cable tray etc. They give up to two hours protection against flame temperatures
in excess of 2012ºF. Our system enables a variety of materials to be selected in order to best meet
the customer specification. This ensures that the design can accommodate difficulties in location
and space restrictions.


#### R K INSULATION ENGINEERS & CONTRACTORS

RK Insulation Engineers & Contractors is a professional engineering driven entity, founded in 2002
with a view to specialize in Thermal insulation, Refrigeration & associated fields.

The company's facilities in Gujarat & Maharashtra both include 3000 square feet of office space, and
10,000 square feet of warehouse storage, in addition to a small office and warehouse at client
sites. With a 120-man crew working throughout the state of Gujarat, the Company has evolved to
become a reliable partner in the insulation, fire stop and fireproofing business.

### Our Clients

#### Contact

Address : 106, Silver Point, Nr. Galaxy Circle, PAL Village, Adajan, Surat-395 009 Gujarat - India


Mob. NO.: +91 9825108320 /

  Higher R-values mean more effective insulation.

Industrial

#### **Industrial Insulation: Why Insulate Piping Systems?**

There are numerous benefits to insulating piping in industrial facilities with fiberglass and
mineral wool insulation products including helping to keep piping systems stable and working safely.

##### **5 great reasons to insulate industrial piping systems**

##### **1. Increases Fire Protection
##### **

A huge benefit in California as wildfires have been more apparent. Fiberglass and mineral wool
insulation are inherently non-combustible.

##### **2. Prevents Condensation and Subsequent Corrosion on Cold Surfaces
##### **

Specifying sufficient insulation thickness with the right vapor retarder is the most effective means
of controlling condensation and limiting corrosion on cold piping, ducts, chillers, and roof drains.
Sufficient thickness is needed to keep the outermost surface temperature above the dew point
temperature of the ambient air.

##### **3. Controls Surface Temperature for Personnel Protection
##### **

Fiberglass and mineral wool insulation systems reduce the surface temperature of piping and
equipment to a safer level, reducing the risk of burns and worker downtime due to injury.

##### **4. Controls and Stabilizes Process Temperatures
##### **

By reducing heat loss or gain, fiberglass and mineral wool insulation help maintain process
temperature to your pre-determined value. Insulation that’s specified to proper thickness can limit
heat loss in a dynamic system or limit temperature drop over time in a static system.

##### **5. Controls Noise and Vibrations
##### **

Pipe insulation materials can be used to encase piping mechanisms that cause noises or vibrations,
forming a sound and vibration barrier between the piping and external areas.

Agriculture

##### **Benefits of Agriculture Building Insulation**

Properly insulated agricultural buildings can make a big impact on your farming operation. Reducing
or eliminating wasted heat in winter and excessive heat build-up in summer can result in huge cost
savings!
* Contributes to maintaining the health of the livestock
* Improves productivity and profitability
* Controls condensation
* Deadens sound

##### **Protect Your Livestock & Your Buildings**
* Poultry Barns
* Hog Barns
* Dairy Barns
* Post Frame Buildings
* Metal Buildings
* Cannabis Farms

#### **Industrial Insulation: Why Insulate Piping Systems?**

There are numerous benefits to insulating piping in industrial facilities with fiberglass and
mineral wool insulation products including helping to keep piping systems stable and working safely.

##### **1. Increases Fire Protection
##### **

A huge benefit in California as wildfires have been more apparent. Fiberglass and mineral wool
insulation are inherently non-combustible.

##### **2. Prevents Condensation and Subsequent Corrosion on Cold Surfaces
##### **

Specifying sufficient insulation thickness with the right vapor retarder is the most effective means
of controlling condensation and limiting corrosion on cold piping, ducts, chillers, and roof drains.
Sufficient thickness is needed to keep the outermost surface temperature above the dew point
temperature of the ambient air.

##### **3. Controls Surface Temperature for Personnel Protection
##### **

Fiberglass and mineral wool insulation systems reduce the surface temperature of piping and
equipment to a safer level, reducing the risk of burns and worker downtime due to injury.

##### **4. Controls and Stabilizes Process Temperatures
##### **

By reducing heat loss or gain, fiberglass and mineral wool insulation help maintain process
temperature to your pre-determined value. Insulation that’s specified to proper thickness can limit
heat loss in a dynamic system or limit temperature drop over time in a static system.

##### **5. Controls Noise and Vibrations
##### **

Pipe insulation materials can be used to encase piping mechanisms that cause noises or vibrations,
forming a sound and vibration barrier between the piping and external areas.

## Budujemy bezpieczeństwo dla zrównoważonego świata

Zwiększamy nasze zaangażowanie w rozwój zrównoważonego budownictwa. Uważnie śledzimy trendy i zmiany
w otaczającym nas świecie. Nieustannie pracujemy nad minimalizacją naszego wpływu na środowisko i
racjonalnym zarządzaniem zasobami. Jako spółka odpowiedzialna społecznie działamy na skalę
międzynarodową, tworząc bezpieczne miejsca pracy dla naszych pracowników.
[ Dowiedz się więcej ][33]

## Selena R&D – Badania i Rozwój

Tworzymy innowacyjne produkty zderzając nowoczesną naukę i potrzeby pracowników budowlanych. Nasze
laboratoria wyposażone są w wysokiej jakości sprzęt analityczny, co pozwala nam dogłębnie
analizować, testować i rozwijać produkty dla branży budowlanej. Łączymy technologie z różnych grup
produktowych tworząc nowe, nieznane dotychczas na rynku, rozwiązania.

## Budujemy bezpieczeństwo dla zrównoważonego świata

Zwiększamy nasze zaangażowanie w rozwój zrównoważonego budownictwa. Uważnie śledzimy trendy i zmiany
w otaczającym nas świecie. Nieustannie pracujemy nad minimalizacją naszego wpływu na środowisko i
racjonalnym zarządzaniem zasobami. Jako spółka odpowiedzialna społecznie działamy na skalę
międzynarodową, tworząc bezpieczne miejsca pracy dla naszych pracowników.

analizować, testować i rozwijać produkty dla branży budowlanej. Łączymy technologie z różnych grup

# SHRUTTAM INSULATION PRIVATE LIMITED – Your Trusted Insulation & Acoustic Material Provider

At **Shruttam Insulation Pvt. Ltd.**, we are not just an insulation company; we are innovators,
problem-solvers, and your trusted partner in creating environments that are safer, quieter, and more
energy-efficient. **Founded in 2016** and based in the heart of India's industrial
landscape—**Ahmedabad, Gujarat**—we have grown to become a prominent name in the manufacturing and
supply of cutting-edge insulation solutions. We specialize in providing innovative and
cost-effective insulation materials that cater to a diverse range of industries, including
**construction, HVAC, industrial plants, and acoustic applications**.

Under the expert leadership of **Mr. Vishal Wagh**, we have rapidly developed a reputation for
delivering high-quality thermal, acoustic, and fire-resistant insulation materials that meet the
demanding needs of industries, commercial enterprises, and residential sectors alike. Whether you
are constructing a building, running a manufacturing plant, or looking to improve your home’s energy
efficiency, Shruttam Insulation provides the products that ensure long-term performance and comfort.

### **Our Vision: Insulating a Better Future**

To revolutionize the insulation industry with innovative solutions that not only protect but also
enhance the performance of buildings and industrial systems. Our vision is to become a global
leader, recognized for delivering sustainable, cost-effective, and high-performance insulation
materials that address the evolving needs of our clients.

### **Our Mission: Crafting Tomorrow's Insulation Solutions**

Our mission is simple—to deliver unparalleled insulation solutions that promote sustainability,
energy efficiency, and safety. We aim to ensure that every product we offer helps businesses and
homeowners alike save energy, enhance acoustic comfort, and meet regulatory standards while reducing
environmental impact.

### **Our Clientele**

Over the years, Shruttam Insulation has worked with a wide range of clients, including large
industrial manufacturers, construction companies, HVAC contractors, and residential developers.
Whether it’s a commercial skyscraper or a private residence, our solutions ensure that buildings are
more comfortable, energy-efficient, and safe.

## What We Offer: Cutting-Edge Insulation Materials for Every Need

At Shruttam Insulation, we offer a comprehensive range of high-performance **insulation materials**,
each designed to meet the unique challenges of a variety of applications. From residential buildings
to high-tech industrial plants, we have you covered.

### **Thermal Insulation**
* **Rockwool & Stonewool (LRB)**: Designed for high-temperature applications, offering excellent
  fire resistance and thermal insulation for industrial environments.
* **Ceramic Wool**: Specialized for extreme heat environments, offering protection for kilns,
  furnaces, and other heat-intensive machinery.
* **Foam Glass**: A lightweight, non-combustible material ideal for thermal insulation in extreme
  conditions.
* **Calcium Silicate**: Providing insulation where both heat resistance and structural integrity are
  crucial, commonly used in power plants.
* **PUF - PIR Pipe Section**: Prevents heat loss in pipes, reducing energy consumption and enhancing
  system efficiency.

### **Cold Insulation**
* **Nitrile Rubber Sheet**: Ideal for refrigeration and HVAC systems, this material provides
  excellent cold insulation while resisting moisture.

# **Cangzhou Shenlong Pipe Manufacturing Co., Ltd. **

Cangzhou Shenlong Pipe Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a company specialized in the production,
processing and sales of various steel pipes and pipe fittings enterprise, the production base is
located in Cangzhou in Hebei. Founded in 1992, covering more than 60,000 square meters, more than
200 employees (including 30 inspectors), annual output of around 150,000 tons of steel pipes, and
40,000 tons pipe fittings. 

**What is our main products include?**
Pipe series: Seamless Steel Pipe, Straight Seam Steel Pipe, Spiral Pipe, Galvanized Steel Pipe;
Pipe Fittings: Elbows, Tees, Reducers, Flanges, etc.
Materials: Carbon Steel, Alloy Steel, Stainless Steel.
Standard: GB, ASME, DIN, JIS, EN, BS, NF, GOST, ISO etc.
As a professional steel pipe manufacturer, we can provide First-Class Quality & Professional
Technical Services !

Smart soundproofing & thermal systems - engineered in Europe, trusted by professionals.

All Sonotiz products are locally developed and produced to meet the highest European standards.

European Manufacturing

SONOTIZ delivers integrated soundproofing and thermal insulation solutions for residential,
commercial, and institutional buildings. Our systems are tested, certified, and tailored to meet
European market standards, providing a reliable barrier against noise and energy loss.

[Man installing soundproofing and thermal insulation material on a wall with Sonotiz branding on
back of shirt]

* Reduce noise by up to 55 dB, in compliance with EN ISO 10140 / ISO 717
* Most products are non-combustible (Euroclass A1/A2)
* Sustainable materials, free from harmful binders or toxic additives
* Manufactured in-house and tested in our own laboratory, ensuring full quality control

page]

### Noise Pollution Impacts Your Health and Comfort

Noise is more than just a nuisance — it’s an economic, functional, and public health issue. Poor

* Decreased productivity
* Sleep disturbances
* Chronic stress and cognitive issues
* Lower property market value

SONOTIZ systems provide real acoustic protection for homes, offices, hospitals, schools, and public
buildings.

## Rapid Insulation Removal & Install Services

[ Insulation Services ][49]

#### Attics

Enjoy an ideal climate in your home and save a ton on energy costs. We will take care of replacing
or adding to existing insulation. Minor repairs and air sealing are a pre-install option. Just let
us know what you need and we'll get the job done.

#### Crawl

Clean out debris in your crawl space and improve your home's air quality. We will handle the dirty
work so you don't have to. Our team can insulate your sub-floor, air ducts and floors in a single
day. We use "green" sanitation methods.

#### Basement

Keep your basement dry and protect mechanical equipment from the elements. We can insulate basements
and convert them into conditioned spaces. Create a climate controlled room for ultimate energy
effiency. Or, just protect you current living spaces better.

#### Walls

Most old properties walls are under-insulated. Reduce noise between rooms or protect from outside
elements. We can install wall insulation into existing walls or open frames. Choose from a wide
range of insulating options to best meet your goals.

#### Foam

Don't worry about the mess or headaches. Get the ultimate climate protection for your home or
business. Nothing competes with spray foam's r-value per square inch and air sealing. We use the
best equipment and closed-cell foam.

#### Commercial

No job is too big for us to handle. We've worked with businesses across the Puget Sound. Our team
has experience in new construction, facility upgrades and rental properties. We'll get the job done
on time and on budget.

#### Sound

Let SI help you meet your soundproofing goals. We have experience in both residential and commercial
installs. ROXUL's sound absorption insulation is among the finest available. Our team can help you
find the best solution for your challenge.

#### Retrofits

Remodeling a room or planning an entire custom home? Let us help you find what type of insulation
retrofit will work the best. We've worked with some of the top remodelers in the state. Our vetted
team is familiar with all the local building codes.

## Thin Film. Thick Film. Real Insulation Science Performance!

**SPI Coatings** is the only insulation-coating manufacturer that developed both **thin-film and
thick-film ceramic systems**, each engineered for a completely different heat-control function.

Thin films are designed to **block radiative** heat at the surface.

Thick films are designed to **hold and control conducted heat** on hot substrates.

They are not interchangeable.

No matter what a manufacturer claims, a thick coating cannot block radiative heat the way a properly
engineered thin ceramic film can. The physics doesn’t allow it.

Most insulation-coating suppliers only offer an average-performing thick film and market it as a
universal solution. Industry is now discovering the limitation.

Between 1989 and 1995, SPI Coatings worked directly with [NASA][146] in a six-year research program
led by the company’s founder, focusing on ceramic compound behaviour. That work identified which
ceramic structures function in thin films and which are required for thick insulation systems.

That knowledge gap still exists today.

There is no other manufacturer with [37 years of continuous ceramic insulation research][147]
producing coatings that perform exactly as claimed. Not four years. Not marketing hype. Proven
performance, delivered for decades.

continents.

Responsive communication and long-term partnership approach focused on trust and continuity.
You’ve have Any Questions?

## Frequently asked questions
* Why do you recommend waterproofing?
  Water penetration can cause corrosion of steel reinforcements within structural elements, reducing
  the load-bearing capacity of a building. Over time, moisture leads to concrete cracking,
  deterioration, and structural damage. Proper waterproofing not only protects the structural
  integrity of a building but also prevents mold, bacteria growth, and unhealthy indoor conditions.
  It ensures a safe, durable, and comfortable living environment by eliminating leaks from roofs,
  foundations, and wet areas. .
* What is Bituminous waterproofing membrane?
  Bituminous waterproofing membranes are protective materials produced by modifying bitumen with
  polymer-based additives. They may be manufactured with or without reinforcement (such as polyester
  felt or fiberglass) to enhance mechanical strength and durability.
* What are the usage areas of bituminous waterproofing membranes?
  Bituminous membranes are used in areas exposed to water infiltration, including:
  * Foundations and basement walls
  * Retaining walls

  * Flat and pitched roofs
  * Wet areas (bathrooms, WC, kitchens)
  * Water tanks, artificial lakes, and pools
  * Highways, bridges, viaducts, and railway systems
  * Parking decks and industrial flooring
  They provide reliable waterproofing in both residential and large-scale infrastructure projects.

# MULTIFOIL INSULATION
# **FOR WARMER HOMES**

Boost your home’s efficiency and cut your energy bills. If you’re looking to take your home
renovation to the next level then our easy-to-fit products help to keep your insulation slim, while
still outperforming traditional materials.

[ REQUEST A SAMPLE PACK ][59] [ FIND AN INSTALLER ][60]

## Changing The Way You Insulate:
## **Why Multifoil is the Future of Insulation**

It’s time to move beyond conventional insulation. We are driving the industry’s transformation to
multifoil because it’s a smarter, more sustainable, and higher-performing solution for every home.
Here’s why it’s time to change the way you insulate.

[ EXPLORE OUR PRODUCT RANGE ][61]
Internal External
* #### Zero Waste on Site
  
  The flexible, easy-to-cut material ensures a perfect fit, virtually eliminating all on-site waste.
* #### Performance That Lasts a Lifetime
  
  Our durable insulation is guaranteed to maintain its thermal performance for over 50 years.
* #### Built on Sustainability
  
  Made from 500 recycled bottles per roll, our insulation is a truly sustainable choice for your
  project.
* #### 3-in-1 Design

## How Internal Multifoil Works

film, multifoil sets a new standard. Unlike traditional materials that only resist the physical
elements of heat transfer, multifoil works to reflect over 90% of radiant heat — providing
protection against every form of heat transfer.
* 1
  
  ### VCL & Radiant Barrier
  
  Offers dual-action, reflecting radiant heat while also blocking moisture to prevent condensation
  and damp.
* 2
  
  ### PET Foil Layer
  
  Reflects radiant heat to keep your home warmer in winter and cooler in summer for year-round
  comfort.
* 3
  
  ### Wadding Layer
  
  This lightweight, recycled core traps air to deliver superior thermal performance and keep your
  home warm.

## How External Multifoil Works

A shining example of how powerful multifoil’s flexibility can be. By providing comprehensive thermal
protection alongside the benefits of a world-class breather membrane, our breathable multifoil
insulation shows the sheer potential of a single product designed to capitalise on the benefits of
more than just one material.
* 1
  
  ### Breathable Membrane
  
  By providing a W1 watertight barrier that still allows water vapour to pass, this ensures your
  build-up can “breathe”.
* 2
  
  ### Internal Foil & Wadding
  
  Together these materials ensure truly comprehensive thermal performance in a lightweight,
  sustainable product.
* 3
  
  ### Perforated PET Foil
  
  Reflecting radiant heat while still allowing water vapour to pass, this layer ensures the complete
  protection of breathable multifoil.

about the company

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.

## innovative products and dedicated service

From our start in 1972, our passion for building science and spray foam innovation has guided
everything we do. And over fifty years later, we are still dedicated to making spray foam the
industry standard in insulation. Working our way from being contractors, to distributors, to
full-scale manufacturers, we’ve honed our spray foam expertise from the inside out.

We believe our spray foam products are the best insulation choice for every home and building, both
for our customers and our planet. As we continue to redefine the benchmark in spray foam insulation,
everything we do is backed by science and built to code to ensure better energy efficiency, added
sustainability, and greater cost savings for our customers. We’re constantly innovating to serve you
better.

## REAL STORIES. REAL RESULTS.

Real world insights from those who install and use our cutting-edge spray foam products.

## innovative products and dedicated service

From our start in 1972, our passion for building science and spray foam innovation has guided
everything we do. And over fifty years later, we are still dedicated to making spray foam the
industry standard in insulation. Working our way from being contractors, to distributors, to
full-scale manufacturers, we’ve honed our spray foam expertise from the inside out.

We believe our spray foam products are the best insulation choice for every home and building, both
for our customers and our planet. As we continue to redefine the benchmark in spray foam insulation,
everything we do is backed by science and built to code to ensure better energy efficiency, added
sustainability, and greater cost savings for our customers. We’re constantly innovating to serve you
better.

Would you like to join in the spray foam conversation? We’d love to share the passion that drives us

We stand behind each of our products and are your long-term partner in providing both quality spray

## Advanced Technical Insulation and Pre-Insulated Piping Solutions

We offer effective, durable and sustainable solutions that prevent energy loss, protect systems, and
ensure reliable performance across heating, cooling, ventilation, and water distribution.

[Our solutions ][122]

### Technical Insulation

Optimize your HVAC/R systems with high-quality insulation that lowers operating costs and reduces
energy use.

### Pre-insulated Piping

Flexible pre-insulated pipes simplify DHC network designs, enabling efficient installation with
factory prefabrications.

### Protection Profile

Recyclable and customizable PE foam that shields products from impact, damage, and scratches.

### Pre-insulated ducting

Pre-insulated ducting systems reduce energy loss, prevent condensation, and lower noise for
efficient ventilation.

The efficiency of insulation depends on the Thermal conductivity of the insulating material. The
lower your thermal conductivity, the less heat is transferred and the better is your insulation
performance. Depending on the size and use of cold rooms, cold rooms can be broadly classified as
Walk-in Cold Room and warehouse cold storages. Thermocol insulation for cold storages is designed
for a fast and easy cold room assembly. We provide Thermocol Insulation Cold Storage at the best
price in India.

Thermocol insulation for cold storage is the most cost-effective and durable core material. It has
much lower water-absorption over time, as compared to Polyurethane foam (PUF), and therefore retains
its insulating properties better over the years.

## Main Content

Innovative products.
Dedicated service.
Concrete results.
[Thermomass product installation]

## Thermomass products boast a forty-year history of trusted performance in integrally insulated
## concrete projects around the world.

Leviat manufactures and distributes a full line of Thermomass insulation systems for use in plant
precast, site-cast tilt-up, and cast-in-place projects. With over 40 years of experience, we are the
undisputed leader in concrete sandwich wall technology and can help you create building envelopes
that maximize energy-efficiency, durability and performance.

Ready to learn more? Please explore the resources available here. If you have a more specific need,
you can [contact our sales team][28], ask a [technical question][29], or [request a quote][30].

As the manufacturer of Thermomass insulation systems, we are passionate about high-performance
walls. For over 40 years, we have helped customers from around the world design and build concrete
sandwich walls that exceeded their expectations for durability, energy-efficiency and environmental
responsibility.

# Why Choose Tri-County Insulation & Acoustical Contractors? 

–>

If you don’t have proper insulation in your home or office, you risk major headaches in the future.
Make sure your new construction or renovation project is energy-efficient and comfortable
year-round.

As a trusted insulation contractor, Tri-County Insulation & Acoustical Contractors has over 40 years
of experience in commercial and residential insulation services. We install fiberglass batt, spray
foam insulation and more to ensure your space has the best comfort and protection from the elements.

We also offer acoustical ceiling installation for commercial buildings to help soundproof, hide
wiring and pipes, and improve energy efficiency. No matter the size of the project, we use
top-quality tools and materials.

Contact us today to start insulating your new construction or renovation project.

### The Tri-County Difference

#### What We Do

We install insulation and acoustical ceilings that improve comfort, energy efficiency, and sound
control for homes and commercial buildings.

#### What We Stand For

We stand for exceptional service, expert installation, and honest communication—earning trust from
homeowners and builders every step of the way.

#### Our Community

Proud to serve our neighbors in Santa Cruz and Santa Maria with trusted insulation and acoustical
solutions for homes and businesses.

#### Your Career

more about joining our team.

### **Injection Wall Foam**

Used on both exterior walls and interior walls, USA Premium Injection Foam is second to none. It is
injected into wall spaces with a fast application process, filling cracks and crevices that most
other insulation products can't. The insulation fills spaces behind electrical and phone wires,
pipes, electrical outlets, and other areas for maximum efficiency.

[More On Injection Foam][66]
[a man installing insulation in an attic]

### **Blown-In Attic Insulation**

When your attic is not properly insulated and ventilated, you can lose conditioned air quickly,
making your home more difficult - and more expensive - to keep comfortable during the winter as well
as the summer. In addition to letting heat escape during the cold winter months, a poorly insulated
attic is a major contributing factor in the formation of ice dams, icicles, and mold growth, which
can be both a health and safety hazard for your family and your property.

[More On Attic Insulation][67]
[a man working in an attic]

### **Air Sealing**

Our highly skilled, trained, and experienced energy and insulation experts can come to your home to
conduct our "Search and Seal" procedure. This process finds and targets the leaks that are hurting
your home's energy efficiency, and seals them off for energy use reduction!

[More On Air Sealing][68]
[a wooden wall cavity]

### **Spray Foam**

Spray polyurethane foam (SPF) is an innovative foam plastic substance that is sprayed onto an open
surface in paint-like form and then expands to create an insulating barrier against wind and outside
temperatures. Once the insulation sets, it expands to create an insulation barrier against extreme
temperatures and moisture.

[More on Spray Foam][69]

## How It Works 
## **Our Proven Process**

Step
Pre-Installation Walkthrough Remove Siding  Drill Holes Inject Foam Fill Wall Cavities Plug Holes
& Reinstall Siding Post-Installation Walkthrough
Slide 0 Slide 1 Slide 2 Slide 3 Slide 4 Slide 5 Slide 6

### Pre-Installation Walkthrough

On installation day, we'll start by walking through the interior and around the exterior of your
home together, explaining our process and what to expect.

### Remove Siding 

For homes with side paneling, we remove them on each section of wall. We can also install on brick,
shingle/shake, block, vinyl, aluminum, stucco and hardie board exteriors.

### Drill Holes

Next, we drill small holes between each wall stud along the side of the home. For homes with brick,
we'll drill holes in the mortar to access the wall.

### Inject Foam

After drilling holes, we then insert a tube through the holes into the wall cavity and begin to pump
in our USA Premium Foam Insulation.

### Fill Wall Cavities

We fill the wall cavity with the injection foam and it squeezes between gaps and crevices, forming
an effective barrier. The insulation product hardens within minutes!

### Plug Holes & Reinstall Siding

After insulating, we plug each hole, or cover with matching mortar, and return the siding to the
home with no visible difference. It'll look like we were never there.

### Post-Installation Walkthrough

We'll walk back through the interior and around the exterior with you, showing you exactly what we
did and ensure that the finished product and clean-up meet your satisfaction.

### **Injection Wall Foam**

Used on both exterior walls and interior walls, USA Premium Injection Foam is second to none. It is
injected into wall spaces with a fast application process, filling cracks and crevices that most
other insulation products can't. The insulation fills spaces behind electrical and phone wires,
pipes, electrical outlets, and other areas for maximum efficiency.

[More On Injection Foam][66]
[a man installing insulation in an attic]

### **Blown-In Attic Insulation**

When your attic is not properly insulated and ventilated, you can lose conditioned air quickly,
making your home more difficult - and more expensive - to keep comfortable during the winter as well
as the summer. In addition to letting heat escape during the cold winter months, a poorly insulated
attic is a major contributing factor in the formation of ice dams, icicles, and mold growth, which
can be both a health and safety hazard for your family and your property.

[More On Attic Insulation][67]
[a man working in an attic]

### **Air Sealing**

Our highly skilled, trained, and experienced energy and insulation experts can come to your home to
conduct our "Search and Seal" procedure. This process finds and targets the leaks that are hurting
your home's energy efficiency, and seals them off for energy use reduction!

[More On Air Sealing][68]
[a wooden wall cavity]

### **Spray Foam**

Spray polyurethane foam (SPF) is an innovative foam plastic substance that is sprayed onto an open
surface in paint-like form and then expands to create an insulating barrier against wind and outside
temperatures. Once the insulation sets, it expands to create an insulation barrier against extreme
temperatures and moisture.

[More on Spray Foam][69]

## How It Works 
## **Our Proven Process**

Step
Pre-Installation Walkthrough Remove Siding  Drill Holes Inject Foam Fill Wall Cavities Plug Holes
& Reinstall Siding Post-Installation Walkthrough
Slide 0 Slide 1 Slide 2 Slide 3 Slide 4 Slide 5 Slide 6

### Pre-Installation Walkthrough

On installation day, we'll start by walking through the interior and around the exterior of your
home together, explaining our process and what to expect.

### Remove Siding 

For homes with side paneling, we remove them on each section of wall. We can also install on brick,
shingle/shake, block, vinyl, aluminum, stucco and hardie board exteriors.

### Drill Holes

Next, we drill small holes between each wall stud along the side of the home. For homes with brick,
we'll drill holes in the mortar to access the wall.

### Inject Foam

After drilling holes, we then insert a tube through the holes into the wall cavity and begin to pump
in our USA Premium Foam Insulation.

### Fill Wall Cavities

We fill the wall cavity with the injection foam and it squeezes between gaps and crevices, forming
an effective barrier. The insulation product hardens within minutes!

### Plug Holes & Reinstall Siding

After insulating, we plug each hole, or cover with matching mortar, and return the siding to the
home with no visible difference. It'll look like we were never there.

### Post-Installation Walkthrough

We'll walk back through the interior and around the exterior with you, showing you exactly what we
did and ensure that the finished product and clean-up meet your satisfaction.

# Effiziente und systemische Klima- und Energielösungen

Über uns

## Viessmann steht für Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovation

Innovationskraft ist der Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Deshalb arbeiten wir seit über 100 Jahren Tag für
Tag daran, die Grenzen des technisch Möglichen neu zu definieren – für unsere Kunden, unsere Partner
und zukünftige Generationen.

[ Mehr über unsere Marke erfahren ][58]
[Das Bild zeigt zwei Viessmann Mitarbeiter in der Produktion mit einer Wärmepumpe]
[Das Bild zeigt einen Mitarbeiter bei der Montage in der Produktionsstätte Allendorf.]
[Das Bild zeigt eine Familie und eine Wärmepumpe.]
[Das Bild zeigt das Hauptgebäude in Allendorf (Eder).]
Lösungen mit System

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.
* #### Wärme und Strom
  
  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][59]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Produkte, einen Mann und eine Frau.]
* #### Klimaanlagen
  
  Optimales Raumklima und hohe Luftqualität – seit 2023 rundet der Bereich Klimaanlagen das
  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][60]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Vitoclima 300S Klimagerät an der Wand montiert]
* #### Lüftung
  
  Einzelne Räume oder gesamte Gebäude – unsere Lüftungssysteme gewährleisten einen geregelten
  Luftaustausch. Das wirkt sich positiv auf Luftqualität und Gebäudesubstanz aus.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]
  [Das Bild zeigt das Ventilation system und ein Mädchen]
* #### Gewerbe und Industrie
  
  Planung, Installation und Wartung – für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für
  eine wirtschaftliche Versorgung mit Wärme, Dampf und Strom.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][62]
  [Das Bild zeigt eine Industrieanlage im Hintergrund und ein Tablet mit Daten im Vordergrund.]
* #### Digitale Services
  
  Steuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung – unsere digitalen Services ebnen den Weg zu noch mehr
  Effizienz und erleichtern sowohl unseren Kunden als auch unseren Partnern den Alltag.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][63]
  [Das Bild zeigt digitale Dienste auf einem Smartphone für die Energiekontrolle in Häusern.]

[Bild zeigt lachende Mitarbeiterin im Viessmann Werk Allendorf.]

Nachhaltigkeit

## Wir leben Nachhaltigkeit

Unsere Herangehensweise an globale Nachhaltigkeitsherausforderungen basiert auf unserem Zweck, eine
lebenswerte Energiezukunft zu sichern. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das Klima und viele andere
Nachhaltigkeitsfragen.

[ Wie wir Nachhaltigkeit umsetzen ][64]
[Das Bild zeigt vier Wintersportlerinnen aus dem Viessmann Team]
Sponsoring

## Wir sind ein Team

Verantwortung zu übernehmen und im Team zu denken, sind wesentliche Bestandteile unserer
Unternehmenskultur. Das zeigt sich auch in unserem Engagement im Sportsponsoring. Seit 1993
unterstützen wir Athleten, Funktionäre sowie Verbände und pflegen enge Partnerschaften.

[ Wie wir uns im Sport engagieren ][65]

Standorte

### Wir sind international

Unser regionaler Hauptsitz ist Allendorf (Eder) in Nordhessen aber wir sind global aktiv. Unsere
effizienten Energie- und Klimalösungen sorgen weltweit für eine zuverlässige und komfortable
Versorgung mit Wärme, Kälte, Luft und Energie.

[ Wo du uns findest ][66]

### Wenn du mehr willst als einfach nur einen Job

Wir haben große Ziele vor Augen. Um diese zu erreichen, setzen wir unsere vielfältigen Talente ein.
Wer zu Viessmann Climate Solutions gehört, gestaltet die Energiewende mit und trägt dazu bei, den
Klimawandel zu bekämpfen.

erneuerbare Energielösungen. Das integrierte Viessmann Climate Solutions Portfolio verbindet

sicheres und verlässliches Wohlfühlklima für die Nutzer:innen. Viessmann Climate Solutions ist Teil
der Carrier Global Corporation, einem weltweit führenden Anbieter intelligenter Klima- und

## Wir leben Nachhaltigkeit

Unsere Herangehensweise an globale Nachhaltigkeitsherausforderungen basiert auf unserem Zweck, eine

## Wir sind ein Team

Verantwortung zu übernehmen und im Team zu denken, sind wesentliche Bestandteile unserer
Unternehmenskultur. Das zeigt sich auch in unserem Engagement im Sportsponsoring. Seit 1993
unterstützen wir Athleten, Funktionäre sowie Verbände und pflegen enge Partnerschaften.

[ Wie wir uns im Sport engagieren ][65]

### Wir sind international

Unser regionaler Hauptsitz ist Allendorf (Eder) in Nordhessen aber wir sind global aktiv. Unsere
effizienten Energie- und Klimalösungen sorgen weltweit für eine zuverlässige und komfortable
Versorgung mit Wärme, Kälte, Luft und Energie.

Klimawandel zu bekämpfen.

## You have found your way to the fastest growing high-temperature insulation solution provider, and
## for good reason.

Vulcor Insulation differentiates itself through its unique Generation III, Ultra Low Shot fiber
products, delivering outstanding thermal performance, superior tensile strength, and smoother
handling. Our solutions are engineered for durability in harsh industrial environments, operating at
temperatures from 700°C up to 1650°C.

Headquartered in the Netherlands, Vulcor Insulation operates sales offices in North America (USA),
the Turan and Middle East region (Turkey), and Central & Eastern Europe (Hungary), supported by a
global network of distribution partners and installers. With large manufacturing capabilities in
Turkey and China, Vulcor manages the development, certification, technical support, logistics, and
global distribution of SoliWool™ fiber-based insulation solutions.

Serving a wide range of industrial markets and applications, Vulcor delivers advanced, energy-saving
insulation technologies worldwide by combining global reach with local expertise. Vulcor Insulation
helps you save energy; efficiently, reliably, and sustainably.

high temperature applications. We offer multiple Refractory Ceramic Fiber chemistry compositions, a
range of Low Bio Persistence Fibers and a range of converted products based on Poly Crystalline Wool
up to 1650°C

 

[Knowledge base ][24]

### Revolutionary Hybrid System

Our Hybrid System combines the best of both worlds: the robust, non-respirable properties of Poly
Crystalline Wool (PCW) on the hot face, and the safe, Low Bio Persistence (LBP) fibers on the cold
face. The microporous interlayer optimally reduces heat transfer, ensuring that the LBP side remains
below 1050 °C, keeping it safe from forming  Respirable Crystalline Silica (RCS).

We are the leading manufacturer of high temperature board products which can be used in many
applications varying from backup behind a dense or insulating lining, in the heat exchanger of a
domestic boiler or for high temperature applications in ceramic kiln. Our state-of-the-art drying
techniques reduced energy consumption by 70% and allow us to manufacture a uniform, lightweight, low
shot and stable board to a thickness of 100 mm.

#### Best Thermal Insulation

ULS technology you have the option to optimize your lining thickness, but we challenge you to reduce
your energy consumption as well as you CO2 emission.

Independently tested, the SoliBlanket ULS-grade outperforms the ‘best in class’ Generation I and
Generation II fiber products with up to 30% improvement on thermal conductivity.

 

#### Toughest Tensile Strength

High temperature fiber blankets are ‘needled’ to convert from a fleece to a blanket. During the
needling process, interlocking for the fibers in the fiberstructure is achieved. High fiber index
and advanced needling technology are crucial to achieve the toughest tensile strength.

With typically 30% higher tensile strength compared to Generation II and 70% higher tensile strength
compared to Generation I fiber, our fiber is delivering the highest strength of all tested fiber
products.

#### Superior Handling

Superior Handling is perhaps our most import feature resulting from the Ultra Low Shot technology,
but the least easy to quantify in numbers. Because; How do you define less fiber dust when working
over head installing the product in the roof of a furnace??

Rest assured that your installation team installing the blankets can tell you the difference.

## You have found your way to the fastest growing high-temperature insulation solution provider, and
## for good reason.

Vulcor Insulation differentiates itself through its unique Generation III, Ultra Low Shot fiber
products, delivering outstanding thermal performance, superior tensile strength, and smoother
handling. Our solutions are engineered for durability in harsh industrial environments, operating at
temperatures from 700°C up to 1650°C.

Headquartered in the Netherlands, Vulcor Insulation operates sales offices in North America (USA),
the Turan and Middle East region (Turkey), and Central & Eastern Europe (Hungary), supported by a
global network of distribution partners and installers. With large manufacturing capabilities in
Turkey and China, Vulcor manages the development, certification, technical support, logistics, and
global distribution of SoliWool™ fiber-based insulation solutions.

Serving a wide range of industrial markets and applications, Vulcor delivers advanced, energy-saving
insulation technologies worldwide by combining global reach with local expertise. Vulcor Insulation
helps you save energy; efficiently, reliably, and sustainably.

[Read our story ][20]

### About Vulcor

Born and raised from the ambition to deliver the best performing thermal insulation solutions for
the industry. Pioneering…

### Knowledge base

As Vulcor we are proud to introduce the first Generation III, Ultra Low Shot fiber in the world. Not
as a premium, or only…

### Product selector

### **S****oliWool High Temperature**

The heart and soul of Vulcor Insulation. SoliWool product range is one of the most extensive fiber
ranges on the market. Targeted to provide the best possible thermal insulation solution for use in
high temperature applications. We offer multiple Refractory Ceramic Fiber chemistry compositions, a
range of Low Bio Persistence Fibers and a range of converted products based on Poly Crystalline Wool
up to 1650°C

 

[Knowledge base ][24]

### Revolutionary Hybrid System

Our Hybrid System combines the best of both worlds: the robust, non-respirable properties of Poly
Crystalline Wool (PCW) on the hot face, and the safe, Low Bio Persistence (LBP) fibers on the cold
face. The microporous interlayer optimally reduces heat transfer, ensuring that the LBP side remains
below 1050 °C, keeping it safe from forming  Respirable Crystalline Silica (RCS).

[SoliWool ][25]

### SoliBoard Productrange

We are the leading manufacturer of high temperature board products which can be used in many
applications varying from backup behind a dense or insulating lining, in the heat exchanger of a
domestic boiler or for high temperature applications in ceramic kiln. Our state-of-the-art drying
techniques reduced energy consumption by 70% and allow us to manufacture a uniform, lightweight, low
shot and stable board to a thickness of 100 mm.

[SoliBoard ][26]
About us

## Let us introduce ourselves

Vulcor Insulation is bringing you the latest generation high temperature fiber products.

If you were to see the factory where we manufacture our SoliWool™ fiber solutions, it is hard to
imagine that back in 2017 it was just a ‘Greenfield’ plan. Today our state of the art factory spans
75.000 m2 (800.000 ft2) and manufactures the most advanced high temperature fibers products.

The SoliWool™ product range consists of engineered bulk fiber, Ultra Low Shot technology blankets,
dust free and smooth papers, flexible felts, high tech manufactured board products, tailored to
shape vacuum formed shapes and one of the widest ranges of fiber modules.

All the SoliWool™ are manufactured with our Generation III, Ultra Low Shot technology. SoliWool™ is
outperforming conventional refractory ceramic fibers (RCF) and low bio persistence fibers (LBP) on
thermal conductivity, mechanical strength and handling.

[


][27]

#### Best Thermal Insulation

ULS technology you have the option to optimize your lining thickness, but we challenge you to reduce
your energy consumption as well as you CO2 emission.

Independently tested, the SoliBlanket ULS-grade outperforms the ‘best in class’ Generation I and
Generation II fiber products with up to 30% improvement on thermal conductivity.

 

#### Toughest Tensile Strength

High temperature fiber blankets are ‘needled’ to convert from a fleece to a blanket. During the
needling process, interlocking for the fibers in the fiberstructure is achieved. High fiber index
and advanced needling technology are crucial to achieve the toughest tensile strength.

With typically 30% higher tensile strength compared to Generation II and 70% higher tensile strength
compared to Generation I fiber, our fiber is delivering the highest strength of all tested fiber
products.

#### Superior Handling

Superior Handling is perhaps our most import feature resulting from the Ultra Low Shot technology,
but the least easy to quantify in numbers. Because; How do you define less fiber dust when working
over head installing the product in the roof of a furnace??

Rest assured that your installation team installing the blankets can tell you the difference.

### Insulated Roof

Vitapur’s insulated roofing panels consist of a top layer of aluminum sheet bonded to a polyurethane
foam core incorporating superior air-tightness and moisture control as well as a high R-value.

[ Learn about Insulated Roof ][58]
[[Pipe Insulation]][59]

### [Pipe Insulation][60]

Pre-cut pipe sections are used to insulate and protect heating and plumbing services within large
diameter pipe systems. Typically, it is used in municipal heating and offshore oil and gas
pipelines, process industries (food and beverage), power stations and refineries

[ Learn about Pipe Insulation ][61]
[[Rockwool Panel]][62]

### [Rockwool Panel][63]

Our Rockwool Panels are not just any ordinary sandwich panels; they are meticulously crafted using
high-density Rockwool cores embedded between two layers of Chromadek (pre-painted galvanized steel)
sheets.

[ Learn about Rockwool Panel ][64]
[[ISO Board]][65]

### [ISO Board][66]

Insulation boards are made of a polyurethane foam core which can be covered with a wide variety of
materials including Kraft paper, Naked, Mineral coated glass fibre tissue, Embossed aluminum foil,
and Bituminized paper.

[ Learn about ISO Board ][67]
[[Sandwich Panels]][68]

### [Sandwich Panel][69]

Vitapur Sandwich panels are cost-efficient prefabricated elements that consist of an inner
insulation core between two colour-coated steel sheet layers. The insulating core in the case of
Vitapur can be Polyurethane or polyisocyanurate.

[ Learn about Sandwich Panel ][70]
[[Sprayfoam Application]][71]

### [Spray Foam][72]

This is derived by on-site mixing of our two basic chemicals, MDI & Polyol; and spraying the
chemical in liquid form onto a surface for it to solidify. The spray foam expands to seal all cracks
and crevices, providing a seamless air barrier.

## Building Trust with Excellence

Zavza Seal stands as a [seasoned general contracting firm][237] driven by a commitment to
excellence, dedicated to serving the vibrant communities of Long Island, encompassing Suffolk,
Nassau, Brooklyn, Queens and Bronx. As a comprehensive construction powerhouse, our expertise spans
waterproofing, insulation, mold remediation, and foundation waterproofing services.

Should you be grappling with water-related issues such as flooding, moisture intrusion, mold
proliferation, or foundation seepage, our expert team is at your service, armed with effective
waterproofing solutions.

[Call US Now (631) 980-1800][238]

## Envisioning Excellence

We strive to evolve into the premier preference for both homeowners and commercial enterprises. Our
aim: to furnish unparalleled insulation, waterproofing, and mold remediation services. Armed with
eco-friendly, state-of-the-art materials, our pledge to exceptional customer service underscores our
quest for open communication, satisfaction, and affordable excellence.

## Our Unwavering Mission

Our mission is rooted in delivering unmatched waterproofing, insulation, and mold remediation
services to our valued clientele – homeowners and businesses alike. We stake our reputation on a
trifecta of best practices, innovation through environmentally conscious products, and exceptional
customer service, all while offering undeniable value.

## Our Vision

To become the preferred choice for homeowners and commercial businesses by providing exceptional
insulation, waterproofing and mold remediation services. By utilizing high-tech, environmentally
friendly materials, and exceptional customer service, we strive to delight our customers and provide
stellar service at affordable prices.

Our Mission

To provide unparalleled waterproofing, insulation and mold remediation services to homeowners and
